metadata.name: Super Synth Lab - Instrument
metadata.description: Streamlined browser synthesizer instrument with piano keyboard, 17 synth engines, effects chain, ADSR/filter shaping, and MIDI I/O

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"><meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent"><meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' data: blob:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self';"><meta http-equiv="X-Frame-Options" content="DENY"><title>Super Synth Lab - Instrument</title><link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json"><link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 180 180'%3E%3Crect width='180' height='180' rx='20' fill='%230a0a1a'/%3E%3Ctext x='90' y='105' text-anchor='middle' font-family='system-ui' font-size='48' font-weight='bold' fill='%234cc9f0'%3ESSLI%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E"><style>
/* === design-tokens.css === */
/* ================================================================
   SSLU Design Tokens — Single Source of Truth
   Super Synth Lab Universe v1.1
   ================================================================
   Every visual value in the app traces back to a token here.
   Screen CSS files should reference var(--sslu-*) instead of
   hardcoded hex colors, pixel sizes, or font stacks.
   ================================================================ */

:root {

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Background Tiers (darkest to lightest)
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-bg-void:         #060610;   /* deepest bg (Calm screen) */
    --sslu-bg-base:         #0a0a12;   /* main app / screen bg */
    --sslu-bg-recessed:     #0a0a1a;   /* recessed areas, modals behind */
    --sslu-bg-surface:      #0d0d1a;   /* sidebar, palette bg */
    --sslu-bg-panel:        #0e0e1a;   /* panels, design engine/filter */
    --sslu-bg-raised:       #111122;   /* top bars, channel strips, cards */
    --sslu-bg-input:        #1a1a2e;   /* input fields, selects, controls */
    --sslu-bg-button:       #2a2a4a;   /* default button bg */
    --sslu-bg-button-hover: #3a3a6a;   /* button hover state */
    --sslu-bg-highlight:    #222244;   /* hovered rows, subtle highlights */
    --sslu-bg-overlay:      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);  /* modal overlays */
    --sslu-bg-frosted:      rgba(10, 10, 26, 0.85); /* glass panels */
    --sslu-bg-subtle:       rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); /* barely-there bg */
    --sslu-bg-subtle-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); /* subtle bg hover */
    --sslu-bg-widget:       rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); /* iso section, controls bar */
    --sslu-bg-widget-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); /* widget hover */
    --sslu-bg-inset:        rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);     /* inset wells, list bg */
    --sslu-bg-canvas:       #0a0a14;   /* scope / waveform canvas bg */

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Primary Accent (Cyan)
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-cyan:            #4cc9f0;
    --sslu-cyan-dim:        rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.6);
    --sslu-cyan-muted:      rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.4);
    --sslu-cyan-subtle:     rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.25);
    --sslu-cyan-ghost:      rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.08);

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Secondary Accent (Purple)
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-purple:          #7209b7;
    --sslu-purple-light:    #9d65c9;
    --sslu-purple-btn:      #3a0ca3;
    --sslu-purple-btn-hover:#5a2cd3;

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Tertiary / Rose-Pink
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-rose:            #f72585;
    --sslu-rose-dim:        rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.4);
    --sslu-rose-subtle:     rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.2);
    --sslu-rose-ghost:      rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.05);

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Sidebar Accent (Indigo)
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-indigo:          #7c6fff;
    --sslu-indigo-dim:      rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.4);
    --sslu-indigo-ghost:    rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.12);

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Functional / Status
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-success:         #3ddc84;   /* playing state, positive */
    --sslu-success-dark:    #1a4a1a;   /* hold/active bg */
    --sslu-success-border:  #3a8a3a;
    --sslu-warning:         #f0a030;   /* caution, playing-pause */
    --sslu-warning-text:    #FFAA44;   /* amber text (no red text rule) */
    --sslu-danger-bg:       #3a1a1a;   /* destructive button bg */
    --sslu-danger-border:   #633;
    --sslu-danger-text:     #ff6666;   /* warm amber-orange for danger */
    --sslu-info:            #4361ee;   /* save/load accent, informational */
    --sslu-info-dim:        rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.3);
    --sslu-info-ghost:      rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.1);

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Instrument Channel Colors
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-inst-0:          #4cc9f0;   /* Bass — cyan */
    --sslu-inst-1:          #2dd4bf;   /* Lead — teal */
    --sslu-inst-2:          #f59e0b;   /* Pad  — amber */
    --sslu-inst-3:          #a78bfa;   /* Sampler — lavender */
    --sslu-inst-master:     #f72585;   /* Master — rose */

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Synth Engine Accent Colors
       Each synthesis type gets a unique accent for its panel.
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-synth-osc:       #4cc9f0;   /* Standard Oscillator */
    --sslu-synth-fm:        #e0a0ff;   /* FM Synthesis */
    --sslu-synth-additive:  #80d0ff;   /* Additive */
    --sslu-synth-granular:  #d0a0ff;   /* Granular */
    --sslu-synth-wavetable: #6644FF;   /* Wavetable */
    --sslu-synth-chip:      #33FF33;   /* Chip / 8-bit */
    --sslu-synth-formant:   #FF7744;   /* Formant */
    --sslu-synth-phasedist: #44FF88;   /* Phase Distortion */
    --sslu-synth-vocoder:   #ff9060;   /* Vocoder */
    --sslu-synth-wavefold:  #FF44AA;   /* Wavefolder */
    --sslu-synth-modal:     #CC8844;   /* Modal Resonator */
    --sslu-synth-physical:  #88CCAA;   /* Physical Modeling */
    --sslu-synth-noise:     #b5179e;   /* Noise */
    --sslu-synth-filter-env:#f72585;   /* Filter Envelope */
    --sslu-synth-lfo:       #00d4aa;   /* LFO */

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — ADSR Fader Colors
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-adsr-attack:     #ff6b6b;
    --sslu-adsr-attack-dark:#c92a2a;
    --sslu-adsr-decay:      #ffd93d;
    --sslu-adsr-decay-dark: #f59f00;
    --sslu-adsr-sustain:    #6bcb77;
    --sslu-adsr-sustain-dark:#2f9e44;
    --sslu-adsr-release:    #4d96ff;
    --sslu-adsr-release-dark:#1971c2;

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Transport
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-transport-play:        #2d9f3a;
    --sslu-transport-play-hover:  #3abb4a;
    --sslu-transport-play-active: #f0a030;
    --sslu-transport-stop:        #c0392b;
    --sslu-transport-stop-hover:  #e74c3c;

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Navigation Group Accents
       Used on the start screen for per-group tinting.
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-nav-play:        rgba(76, 201, 240, 1);   /* cyan */
    --sslu-nav-explore:     rgba(138, 80, 255, 1);   /* purple */
    --sslu-nav-sound:       rgba(0, 210, 180, 1);    /* teal */
    --sslu-nav-compose:     rgba(247, 37, 133, 1);   /* rose */
    --sslu-nav-train:       rgba(100, 100, 240, 1);  /* indigo */
    --sslu-nav-discover:    rgba(255, 200, 60, 1);   /* gold */
    --sslu-nav-tools:       rgba(255, 180, 50, 1);   /* amber */

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Text
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-text-primary:    #ffffff;
    --sslu-text-secondary:  #ccddee;
    --sslu-text-body:       #c0c0dd;
    --sslu-text-label:      #9999bb;
    --sslu-text-muted:      #8888aa;
    --sslu-text-dim:        #667;
    --sslu-text-faint:      #555;
    --sslu-text-placeholder:#555;
    --sslu-text-accent:     var(--sslu-cyan);

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Borders
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-border-subtle:   #1a1a2e;
    --sslu-border-default:  #2a2a4a;
    --sslu-border-medium:   #333355;
    --sslu-border-strong:   #444466;
    --sslu-border-hover:    #666;
    --sslu-border-accent:   var(--sslu-cyan);
    --sslu-border-faint:    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    --sslu-border-faint-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    --sslu-border-widget:   rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.2);
    --sslu-border-widget-strong: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.4);

    /* ============================================================
       COLOR — Gradients
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-gradient-body:   linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%);
    --sslu-gradient-brand:  linear-gradient(90deg, #4cc9f0, #7209b7);
    --sslu-gradient-brand-wide: linear-gradient(90deg, #4cc9f0, #7209b7, #f72585, #4cc9f0);
    --sslu-gradient-btn-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, #4361ee, #3a0ca3);
    --sslu-gradient-btn-save: linear-gradient(135deg, #06d6a0, #118ab2);
    --sslu-gradient-btn-import: linear-gradient(135deg, #f77f00, #e36414);
    --sslu-gradient-btn-export: linear-gradient(135deg, #7209b7, #560bad);
    --sslu-gradient-start-bg: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0a1a 0%, #14142e 25%, #1a0a2e 50%, #0a1a2e 75%, #0a0a1a 100%);

    /* ============================================================
       TYPOGRAPHY — Font Family
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-font-family:     system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    --sslu-font-mono:       monospace;

    /* ============================================================
       TYPOGRAPHY — Font Sizes (unified scale)
       Named semantically. Every font-size in the app maps to one.
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-fs-h1:           1.15rem;   /* main title */
    --sslu-fs-h2:           0.85rem;   /* panel h3, section titles */
    --sslu-fs-h3:           0.8rem;    /* sub-section titles */
    --sslu-fs-h4:           0.75rem;   /* modal section titles */
    --sslu-fs-body:         0.7rem;    /* standard labels, controls */
    --sslu-fs-body-sm:      0.65rem;   /* smaller labels, hints */
    --sslu-fs-small:        0.65rem;   /* badges, fine print */
    --sslu-fs-tiny:         0.625rem;  /* compact mode labels (min 10px) */
    --sslu-fs-micro:        0.625rem;  /* action buttons, save/load (min 10px) */
    --sslu-fs-nano:         0.625rem;  /* status messages (min 10px) */
    --sslu-fs-icon:         18px;      /* sidebar icon default */
    --sslu-fs-icon-lg:      32px;      /* start screen icons */
    --sslu-fs-icon-hero:    42px;      /* hero star */

    /* Pixel-based sizes (for elements that mix with px layouts) */
    --sslu-fs-px-xs:        10px;
    --sslu-fs-px-sm:        10px;
    --sslu-fs-px-base:      11px;
    --sslu-fs-px-md:        12px;
    --sslu-fs-px-lg:        13px;
    --sslu-fs-px-xl:        14px;
    --sslu-fs-px-2xl:       22px;

    /* ============================================================
       TYPOGRAPHY — Font Weights
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-fw-normal:       400;
    --sslu-fw-medium:       600;
    --sslu-fw-bold:         700;
    --sslu-fw-heavy:        800;
    --sslu-fw-black:        900;

    /* ============================================================
       TYPOGRAPHY — Letter Spacing
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-ls-tight:        0.03em;
    --sslu-ls-normal:       0.05em;
    --sslu-ls-wide:         0.08em;
    --sslu-ls-wider:        1px;
    --sslu-ls-widest:       1.5px;
    --sslu-ls-hero:         3px;
    --sslu-ls-mega:         5px;
    --sslu-ls-ultra:        10px;

    /* ============================================================
       SPACING — Scale (4px base)
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-space-0:         0;
    --sslu-space-1:         2px;
    --sslu-space-2:         4px;
    --sslu-space-3:         6px;
    --sslu-space-4:         8px;
    --sslu-space-5:         10px;
    --sslu-space-6:         12px;
    --sslu-space-8:         16px;
    --sslu-space-10:        20px;
    --sslu-space-12:        24px;
    --sslu-space-16:        32px;

    /* Rem spacing for fluid layouts */
    --sslu-gap-xs:          0.15rem;
    --sslu-gap-sm:          0.25rem;
    --sslu-gap-md:          0.4rem;
    --sslu-gap-lg:          0.5rem;
    --sslu-gap-xl:          0.6rem;
    --sslu-gap-2xl:         0.8rem;
    --sslu-gap-3xl:         1rem;
    --sslu-gap-4xl:         1.2rem;

    /* Padding shorthands */
    --sslu-pad-panel:       0.4rem;
    --sslu-pad-section:     0.5rem;
    --sslu-pad-bar:         0.3rem 0.6rem;
    --sslu-pad-btn:         2px 8px;
    --sslu-pad-btn-lg:      0.3rem 0.5rem;
    --sslu-pad-input:       2px 6px;

    /* ============================================================
       BORDERS — Radius
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-radius-xs:       2px;
    --sslu-radius-sm:       3px;
    --sslu-radius-md:       4px;
    --sslu-radius-lg:       6px;
    --sslu-radius-xl:       8px;
    --sslu-radius-2xl:      10px;
    --sslu-radius-3xl:      14px;
    --sslu-radius-pill:     50%;
    --sslu-radius-round:    9999px;

    /* ============================================================
       BORDERS — Width
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-border-w-thin:   1px;
    --sslu-border-w-medium: 1.5px;
    --sslu-border-w-thick:  2px;
    --sslu-border-w-heavy:  3px;

    /* ============================================================
       SHADOWS
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-shadow-sm:       0 2px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    --sslu-shadow-md:       0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    --sslu-shadow-lg:       0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    --sslu-shadow-glow-cyan: 0 0 6px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.3);
    --sslu-shadow-glow-rose: 0 0 8px rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.4);
    --sslu-shadow-glow-info: 0 8px 32px rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.3);
    --sslu-shadow-glow-success: 0 0 10px rgba(102, 255, 102, 0.6);
    --sslu-shadow-key:      0 2px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    --sslu-shadow-key-black:0 2px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    --sslu-shadow-none:     none;

    /* ============================================================
       TRANSITIONS
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-transition-fast:   0.05s;
    --sslu-transition-normal: 0.15s;
    --sslu-transition-slow:   0.2s;
    --sslu-transition-slower:  0.3s;
    --sslu-transition-ease:   ease;
    --sslu-transition-ease-out: ease-out;

    /* Composite transitions */
    --sslu-tr-bg:           background var(--sslu-transition-normal);
    --sslu-tr-color:        color var(--sslu-transition-normal);
    --sslu-tr-border:       border-color var(--sslu-transition-normal);
    --sslu-tr-all:          all var(--sslu-transition-normal);
    --sslu-tr-transform:    transform var(--sslu-transition-normal) var(--sslu-transition-ease);

    /* ============================================================
       Z-INDEX — Layering
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-z-base:          1;
    --sslu-z-keys-white:    1;
    --sslu-z-keys-black:    2;
    --sslu-z-sidebar:       100;
    --sslu-z-overlay:       350;
    --sslu-z-analyzer:      401;
    --sslu-z-dot-toggle:    9999;
    --sslu-z-sidebar-fs:    10000;

    /* ============================================================
       SIZING — Interactive Controls
       (carried over from quad-layout.css, extended)
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-knob-size:       72px;
    --sslu-key-width:       48px;
    --sslu-fader-height:    200px;
    --sslu-pad-size:        100px;
    --sslu-nav-height:      0px;

    /* Touch target minimums */
    --sslu-touch-min:       44px;

    /* Keyboard dimensions */
    --sslu-key-white-w:     32px;
    --sslu-key-white-h:     140px;
    --sslu-key-black-w:     22px;
    --sslu-key-black-h:     88px;

    /* Mini keyboard dimensions */
    --sslu-mini-key-white-w: 36px;
    --sslu-mini-key-black-w: 24px;
    --sslu-mini-key-h:       60px;

    /* Fader dimensions */
    --sslu-fader-w:          12px;
    --sslu-fader-h:          70px;
    --sslu-fader-track-w:    6px;
    --sslu-fader-thumb-w:    14px;
    --sslu-fader-thumb-h:    8px;

    /* Content max-widths */
    --sslu-max-w-content:   960px;
    --sslu-max-w-start:     1100px;

    /* Safe area insets */
    --sslu-safe-bottom:     env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
    --sslu-safe-top:        env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
    --sslu-safe-left:       env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px);
    --sslu-safe-right:      env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px);

    /* ============================================================
       SIZING — Slider Thumb (effects, design)
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-slider-track-h:  6px;
    --sslu-slider-thumb-w:  12px;
    --sslu-slider-thumb-h:  12px;
    --sslu-slider-track-bg: #333;
    --sslu-slider-thumb-bg: var(--sslu-purple);

    /* Master slider */
    --sslu-slider-master-track-h: 8px;
    --sslu-slider-master-thumb:   16px;

    /* ============================================================
       BACKDROP FILTER
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-backdrop-blur:   blur(8px);

    /* ============================================================
       OPACITY
       ============================================================ */
    --sslu-opacity-disabled: 0.4;
    --sslu-opacity-muted:    0.6;
    --sslu-opacity-subtab:   0.85;

    /* ============================================================
       SSLI DESIGN SYSTEM TOKENS
       New --ssli-* prefix tokens aligned with design-system.json.
       Existing --sslu-* tokens are preserved for backward compat.
       ============================================================ */

    /* --- SSLI Background Surfaces --- */
    --ssli-bg-surface:      #0e1117;
    --ssli-bg-elevated:     #161b22;
    --ssli-bg-overlay:      #1c2128;
    --ssli-bg-input:        #21262d;

    /* --- SSLI Text --- */
    --ssli-text-primary:    rgba(220, 235, 245, 0.95);
    --ssli-text-secondary:  rgba(220, 235, 245, 0.70);
    --ssli-text-muted:      rgba(220, 235, 245, 0.50);
    --ssli-text-disabled:   rgba(220, 235, 245, 0.35);

    /* --- SSLI Accent Colors --- */
    --ssli-accent-cyan:     #00d4ff;
    --ssli-accent-purple:   #a855f7;
    --ssli-accent-rose:     #f43f5e;
    --ssli-accent-amber:    #f59e0b;
    --ssli-accent-green:    #22c55e;
    --ssli-accent-orange:   #f97316;

    /* --- SSLI Note Colors (chromatic) --- */
    --ssli-note-C:          #ff3344;
    --ssli-note-Cs:         #ff6622;
    --ssli-note-D:          #ff9900;
    --ssli-note-Ds:         #ddbb00;
    --ssli-note-E:          #aadd00;
    --ssli-note-F:          #44cc44;
    --ssli-note-Fs:         #00bbaa;
    --ssli-note-G:          #0099dd;
    --ssli-note-Gs:         #3366ff;
    --ssli-note-A:          #6644ff;
    --ssli-note-As:         #9933dd;
    --ssli-note-B:          #cc33aa;

    /* --- SSLI Surface Themes --- */
    --ssli-theme-warm-accent:   #d4a040;
    --ssli-theme-warm-bg:       #1a1610;
    --ssli-theme-cool-accent:   #4488cc;
    --ssli-theme-cool-bg:       #101418;
    --ssli-theme-neutral-accent:#888888;
    --ssli-theme-neutral-bg:    #141414;

    /* --- SSLI Spacing --- */
    --ssli-space-xxs:       2px;
    --ssli-space-xs:        4px;
    --ssli-space-sm:        6px;
    --ssli-space-md:        8px;
    --ssli-space-lg:        12px;
    --ssli-space-xl:        16px;
    --ssli-space-xxl:       24px;

    /* --- SSLI Gap (px-based) --- */
    --ssli-gap-xs:          4px;
    --ssli-gap-sm:          6px;
    --ssli-gap-md:          8px;
    --ssli-gap-lg:          12px;

    /* --- SSLI Touch Targets --- */
    --ssli-touch-min:       44px;
    --ssli-touch-comfortable: 48px;
    --ssli-touch-large:     56px;
    --ssli-touch-phone-min: 36px;

    /* --- SSLI Border Radius --- */
    --ssli-radius-sm:       3px;
    --ssli-radius-md:       6px;
    --ssli-radius-lg:       8px;
    --ssli-radius-round:    50%;

    /* --- SSLI Opacity --- */
    --ssli-opacity-active:  1.0;
    --ssli-opacity-hover:   0.85;
    --ssli-opacity-inactive:0.60;
    --ssli-opacity-disabled:0.40;
    --ssli-opacity-overlay: 0.20;
    --ssli-opacity-subtle:  0.12;

    /* --- SSLI Layout --- */
    --ssli-topbar-h:        36px;
    --ssli-topbar-h-phone:  32px;
    --ssli-header-padding:  6px 8px;
    --ssli-button-gap:      4px;
    --ssli-section-gap:     8px;
    --ssli-safe-area-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);

    /* --- SSLI Controls --- */
    --ssli-slider-track-h:  6px;
    --ssli-slider-thumb-size: 18px;
    --ssli-dropdown-h:      28px;
    --ssli-dropdown-h-phone:24px;

    /* --- SSLI Typography Scale (px) --- */
    --ssli-fs-xs:           10px;
    --ssli-fs-sm:           11px;
    --ssli-fs-body:         13px;
    --ssli-fs-md:           14px;
    --ssli-fs-lg:           16px;
    --ssli-fs-xl:           18px;
    --ssli-fs-h3:           20px;
    --ssli-fs-h2:           24px;
    --ssli-fs-h1:           28px;

    /* --- SSLI Typography Weights --- */
    --ssli-fw-normal:       400;
    --ssli-fw-medium:       500;
    --ssli-fw-semibold:     600;
    --ssli-fw-bold:         700;

    /* --- SSLI Human Factors --- */
    --ssli-finger-spacing:  50px;
    --ssli-ios-landscape-h: 375px;
    --ssli-ios-portrait-h:  710px;
}

/* ================================================================
   RESPONSIVE OVERRIDES — Phone Portrait
   ================================================================ */
[data-layout="phone"] {
    --sslu-knob-size:       56px;
    --sslu-key-width:       36px;
    --sslu-fader-height:    150px;
    --sslu-pad-size:        80px;
    --sslu-nav-height:      56px;
    --sslu-key-white-w:     28px;
    --sslu-key-black-w:     18px;
    --sslu-mini-key-white-w: 28px;
    --sslu-mini-key-black-w: 18px;
}

/* ================================================================
   RESPONSIVE OVERRIDES — Phone Landscape
   ================================================================ */
[data-layout="phone-land"] {
    --sslu-knob-size:       52px;
    --sslu-key-width:       44px;
    --sslu-fader-height:    120px;
    --sslu-pad-size:        72px;
    --sslu-nav-height:      44px;
}

/* ================================================================
   RESPONSIVE OVERRIDES — Tablet
   ================================================================ */
[data-layout="tablet"] {
    --sslu-knob-size:       64px;
    --sslu-key-width:       44px;
    --sslu-fader-height:    180px;
    --sslu-pad-size:        90px;
}

/* ================================================================
   HIGH CONTRAST MODE
   ================================================================ */
.ssl-high-contrast {
    --sslu-text-primary:    #ffffff;
    --sslu-text-secondary:  #ffffff;
    --sslu-text-label:      #ffffff;
    --sslu-bg-base:         #000000;
    --sslu-bg-surface:      #000000;
    --sslu-bg-raised:       #000000;
    --sslu-cyan:            #ffff00;
    --sslu-border-default:  #ffffff;
    --sslu-border-medium:   #ffffff;
}

/* ================================================================
   PREFERS-CONTRAST: MORE — OS-level high contrast
   ================================================================ */
@media (prefers-contrast: more) {
    :root {
        --sslu-bg-base:         #000;
        --sslu-text-primary:    #fff;
        --sslu-border-default:  rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
    }
}

/* ================================================================
   DESKTOP MINIMUM FONT SIZE — ensure readability on all labels
   ================================================================ */
@media (min-width: 769px) {
    label,
    button,
    select,
    .sidebar-label,
    .effects-row-name,
    .effects-row-param-label,
    .effects-cat-header,
    .harmony-chord-btn,
    .rhythm-grid-row-controls .row-name,
    .calm-palette-category-label,
    .sslu-quad-header,
    .slot-numeral,
    .slot-name {
        font-size: max(var(--sslu-fs-px-md), 12px);
    }
}


/* === base.css === */
/**
 * base.css - Global Styles for Synth Lab
 * Reset, layout, header, and controls
 */

/* ========================================
   Reset
   ======================================== */

/* === iOS TOUCH CALLOUT PREVENTION — UNIVERSAL ===
   -webkit-touch-callout is NON-INHERITED in WebKit.
   Must be set directly on every element. The * selector
   with !important guarantees no specificity override. */
*, *::before, *::after {
    -webkit-touch-callout: none !important;
}

/* Disable text selection on everything EXCEPT inputs and textareas */
*:not(input):not(textarea):not(select) {
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -moz-user-select: none;
    -ms-user-select: none;
    user-select: none;
}

/* Global reset + touch manipulation (prevents double-tap zoom) */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    touch-action: manipulation;
}

/* Range inputs need touch-action: none to allow thumb dragging */
input[type="range"] {
    touch-action: none;
}

/* Performance areas — suppress ALL gesture recognition */
.perform-ctrl-wrapper,
.perform-ctrl-wrapper *,
#ssliKeyboard,
#ssliKeyboard *,
.keyboard,
.keyboard * {
    touch-action: none;
}

/* U-13: Focus-visible + focus fallback for accessibility */
*:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--sslu-cyan, var(--ssli-accent-cyan));
    outline-offset: 2px;
}
*:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
    outline: none;
}

/* ========================================
   Body
   ======================================== */

body {
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-family);
    background: var(--sslu-gradient-body);
    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;
    max-height: 100vh;
    max-height: 100dvh;
    display: flex;
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* A-13: Subtle radial vignette — only on landing page to save GPU compositing.
   Uses will-change: transform to promote to own layer when visible. */
body.ssl-landing-visible::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, rgba(10, 10, 26, 0.0) 0%, rgba(5, 5, 16, 0.4) 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
    will-change: transform;
}

/* When landing page is visible, allow body to scroll for it */
body.ssl-landing-visible {
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    height: auto;
    max-height: none;
    /* Background breathing pulse — driven by --sslu-pulse from analyzer.js */
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 80px rgba(76, 201, 240, var(--sslu-pulse, 0));
}

/* BPM pulse bar — thin line at bottom of active screen */
.sslu-bpm-pulse-bar {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.5);
    z-index: 9998;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes sslu-bpm-pulse {
    0% { opacity: 0.7; }
    20% { opacity: 0.15; }
    100% { opacity: 0; }
}

.sslu-bpm-pulse-bar.pulse {
    animation: sslu-bpm-pulse var(--sslu-bpm-duration, 0.5s) ease-out;
}

/* ========================================
   Container
   ======================================== */

.container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-panel);
    padding-top: 2.5rem; /* Clear Clairvoyance exhibit viewer header overlay */
    overflow-y: auto;
}

/* ========================================
   Header
   ======================================== */

.header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-lg);
    margin-bottom: var(--sslu-gap-xs);
}

h1 {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h1);
    background: var(--sslu-gradient-brand);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

.version {
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-md);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
}

/* ========================================
   Controls
   ======================================== */

.controls {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-sm);
    margin-bottom: var(--sslu-gap-xs);
    padding: 0.2rem;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-widget);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
}

.controls label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.12rem;
    color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
}

.controls select,
.controls input[type=number] {
    padding: 0.08rem 0.15rem;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
}

.controls input[type=number] {
    width: 48px;
}

/* ========================================
   Loading Status
   ======================================== */

.loading-status {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    margin-left: var(--sslu-gap-lg);
}

/* ========================================
   Classic Screen - Layout Constraints
   All sections constrained to sequencer width for cohesion
   ======================================== */

#screen-classic .controls,
#screen-classic .kb-iso-row,
#screen-classic .adsr-panel,
#screen-classic .osc-mixer,
#screen-classic .filter-inline,
#screen-classic .noise-inline,
#screen-classic .filter-env-inline,
#screen-classic .seq-section,
#screen-classic .melody-panel,
#screen-classic .iso-section,
#screen-classic .classic-collapse,
#screen-classic .header,
#screen-classic #stretchPanel,
#screen-classic #arpPanel,
#screen-classic .arp-inst-group,
#screen-classic .inst-filter-group,
#screen-classic .midi-bar,
#screen-classic #midiBar {
    max-width: var(--sslu-max-w-content);
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
}

/* Classic collapse headers - consistent styling */
.classic-collapse-header {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-lg) !important;
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-text-secondary);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-wider);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: var(--sslu-space-3) var(--sslu-space-4);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-subtle);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    margin-bottom: var(--sslu-space-2);
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
}

.classic-collapse-header:hover {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-subtle-hover);
    color: var(--sslu-text-secondary);
}

/* Classic screen consistent label styling */
#screen-classic .controls label {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
    color: var(--sslu-text-label);
}

#screen-classic .controls select,
#screen-classic .controls input[type=number] {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-input);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: var(--sslu-text-secondary);
    border: 1px solid var(--ssli-bg-input);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

/* Note readout - more prominent */
#screen-classic .note-readout {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-lg);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
}

/* Classic screen buttons - consistent sizing */
#screen-classic .kb-controls button {
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-5);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
    font-family: inherit;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid var(--ssli-bg-input);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

#screen-classic .kb-controls button:hover {
    background: var(--sslu-purple-btn);
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    border-color: var(--sslu-purple-btn-hover);
}

/* Octave range display */
#screen-classic #octRange {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-md);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
}

/* Classic page collapse expanders */
.classic-collapse{border-bottom:1px solid var(--sslu-bg-highlight);margin:0;}
.classic-collapse-header{font-size:var(--sslu-fs-px-lg);font-weight:var(--sslu-fw-bold);color:var(--sslu-text-secondary);padding:6px 10px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--sslu-bg-panel);list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);user-select:none;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:var(--sslu-ls-wider);}
.classic-collapse-header::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
.classic-collapse-header::before{content:"\25B6";font-size:var(--sslu-fs-px-xs);transition:transform var(--sslu-transition-normal);}
.classic-collapse[open]>.classic-collapse-header::before{transform:rotate(90deg);}
.classic-collapse-header:hover{color:var(--sslu-text-secondary);background:#111125;}

/* ========================================
   Quad-Fill: stretch Classic content to fill quads
   ======================================== */

.sslu-quad .container {
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.sslu-quad #screen-classic {
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* Keyboard section in Q1 should expand to fill quad */
.sslu-quad .kb-iso-row {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    align-items: stretch;
}

.sslu-quad .kb-section {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.sslu-quad .keyboard {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 100px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
}

/* Keys should shrink to fit quad width and stretch to quad height */
.sslu-quad .keyboard .key {
    flex-shrink: 1;
}

.sslu-quad .keyboard .key.white {
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 18px;
}

.sslu-quad .keyboard .key.black {
    height: 63%;
    min-width: 12px;
}

/* Controls in Q2 should flex-fill */
.sslu-quad .controls {
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Sequencer/analyzer in Q3 should expand */
.sslu-quad .seq-section {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
}

.sslu-quad .seq-section canvas {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 80px;
    width: 100%;
}

/* Phone: classic content fills full screen */
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-quad .container {
    height: 100%;
    padding-top: 0.4rem;
}

[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-quad .keyboard {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 100px;
}

/* ========================================
   Phone-Landscape: Classic Screen
   Fill Q0 viewport with keyboard, hide orphaned sections
   ======================================== */

/* Hide the Generators <details> that lives outside the quad wrapper */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic > details.classic-collapse,
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic > .container > details.classic-collapse {
    display: none;
}

/* But SHOW <details> inside quads (Q3 Sequencer needs it visible) */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad details.classic-collapse {
    display: block;
}

/* Classic screen: override .ssl-screen defaults for phone-land */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    max-height: 100vh;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* Container fills the screen */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic > .container {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
    height: 100%;
    padding-top: 0;
    padding-bottom: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* Quad wrapper fills the container */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic > .container > .sslu-quad-wrapper {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
    height: 100%;
}

/* Hide header bar in phone-land OUTSIDE quads (title/version) — keyboard is the focus */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic > .container > .header {
    display: none;
}

/* But SHOW header inside quads (Q2 needs it visible) */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad .header {
    display: flex;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    padding: 4px 8px;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-md);
}

/* Show controls inside quads for phone-land (Q2 content) */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad .controls {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);
    padding: 6px 8px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad .controls label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad .controls select,
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad .controls input[type=number] {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    padding: 2px 4px;
    min-height: 24px;
}

/* Hide controls bar in phone-land (available on Q1) */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic > .container > .controls {
    display: none;
}

/* kb-iso-row: expand to fill Q0 */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad .kb-iso-row {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
}

/* kb-section: expand to fill kb-iso-row */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad .kb-section {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* Keyboard: expand to fill available height */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad .keyboard {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 80px;
    height: auto;
}

/* White keys: fill the full keyboard height */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad .keyboard .key.white {
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
}

/* Black keys: proportional to white (63%) */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad .keyboard .key.black {
    height: 63%;
    min-height: 0;
}

/* Compact the controls and readout so keyboard gets more space */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad .kb-controls {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 2px 0;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad .note-readout {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    min-height: auto;
    padding: 1px 0;
}

/* Compact the MIDI bar */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad #midiBar {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
}

/* Classic Q2: sequencer section — force content to fit within quad */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad-2 {
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* Collapse the sequencer details and constrain height */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad-2 > * {
    max-height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* Classic Q2: compact controls row */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad-2 .controls {
    padding: 2px 4px;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* Classic Q2: compact ADSR panel */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-classic .sslu-quad-2 .adsr-panel {
    padding: 2px 4px;
    gap: 1px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ========================================
   Focus Mode — Classic screen simplified
   Hides synth controls, sequencer, etc.
   ======================================== */
.ssl-focus-mode .sslu-quad-2,
.ssl-focus-mode .sslu-quad-3,
.ssl-focus-mode details.classic-collapse {
    display: none !important;
}

.ssl-focus-mode .sslu-quad-1 {
    flex: 1;
    max-height: none;
}

.ssl-focus-btn {
    position: absolute;
    top: 4px;
    right: 4px;
    z-index: 10;
    background: rgba(30, 30, 60, 0.8);
    border: 1px solid rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.3);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-lg);
    color: #aaa;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-family: inherit;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}

.ssl-focus-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(50, 50, 90, 0.9);
    border-color: rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.5);
    color: #ddd;
}

.ssl-focus-btn.active {
    background: rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.25);
    border-color: rgba(120, 100, 255, 0.6);
    color: #fff;
}

/* Screen title bar (Fix 22) */
.ssl-screen-title-bar {
    height: 20px;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-surface, #111122);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan, var(--ssli-accent-cyan));
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-subtle, #1a1a33);
}

/* Onboarding tooltip (Fix 20 — non-blocking floating card) */
.ssl-onboarding-tooltip {
    position: fixed;
    top: 12px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 15000;
    pointer-events: auto;
    background: rgba(10, 10, 30, 0.92);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-cyan, var(--ssli-accent-cyan));
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-lg);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.25);
    animation: ssl-ob-fadein 0.4s ease-out;
    max-width: 360px;
    font-family: inherit;
}
@keyframes ssl-ob-fadein {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-12px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
}
.ssl-onboarding-tooltip-text {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-md);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan, var(--ssli-accent-cyan));
    white-space: nowrap;
}
.ssl-onboarding-tooltip-close {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: var(--ssli-text-muted, #888);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-h3);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0 2px;
    line-height: 1;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ssl-onboarding-tooltip-close:hover {
    color: #fff;
}

/* WAV recording indicator (Fix 19) */
.ssl-rec-indicator {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);
    color: var(--sslu-warning-text, #FFAA44);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
}
.ssl-rec-dot {
    width: 10px; height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #ff4444;
    animation: ssl-rec-blink 1s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ssl-rec-blink {
    0%,100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0.2; }
}
.ssl-rec-btn {
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border: 1px solid #ff4444;
    background: rgba(255,68,68,0.15);
    color: var(--sslu-warning-text, #FFAA44);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
}
.ssl-rec-btn.recording {
    background: rgba(255,68,68,0.35);
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #ff6666;
}

/* Glide tip overlay (Fix 27) */
.ssl-glide-tip {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 100;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
}
.ssl-glide-tip.hiding {
    opacity: 0;
}
.ssl-glide-finger {
    font-size: 36px;
    animation: ssl-glide-slide 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ssl-glide-slide {
    0% { transform: translateX(-40px); }
    50% { transform: translateX(40px); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-40px); }
}
.ssl-glide-text {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-lg);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan, var(--ssli-accent-cyan));
    margin-top: 8px;
}

/* Kids exit lock overlay (Fix 26) */
.ssl-kids-exit-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
    z-index: 19000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xl);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
}

/* Undo button (Fix 25) */
.ssl-undo-btn {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 8px;
    right: 8px;
    width: 32px; height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-surface, #111122);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-subtle, #1a1a33);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan, var(--ssli-accent-cyan));
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    z-index: 9000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-inactive);
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.ssl-undo-btn:hover {
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
}
.ssl-undo-btn:disabled {
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-overlay);
    cursor: default;
}

/* ========================================
   Reset Confirmation Dialog
   ======================================== */

.ssl-reset-confirm-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-overlay, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75));
    z-index: 99999;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.ssl-reset-confirm-card {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-panel, var(--ssli-bg-surface));
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-subtle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08));
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg, 12px);
    padding: 24px 28px;
    max-width: 380px;
    width: 90%;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
}

.ssl-reset-confirm-title {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xl);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary, #e0e0f0);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.ssl-reset-confirm-msg {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-md);
    color: var(--sslu-text-secondary, #9999bb);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.ssl-reset-confirm-buttons {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-lg);
    justify-content: center;
}

.ssl-reset-confirm-cancel,
.ssl-reset-confirm-ok {
    padding: 8px 24px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md, 6px);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-subtle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08));
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-md);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: filter 0.15s;
}

.ssl-reset-confirm-cancel {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-button, var(--ssli-bg-input));
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary, #e0e0f0);
}

.ssl-reset-confirm-cancel:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.2);
}

.ssl-reset-confirm-ok {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e07020, #cc5500);
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #e07020;
}

.ssl-reset-confirm-ok:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.2);
}

/* ========================================
   Master Mute / Panic Button (Fix R11)
   ======================================== */

.sslu-master-mute-btn {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 12px;
    right: 12px;
    z-index: 9999;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    min-width: 44px;
    min-height: 44px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid var(--sslu-border-strong, #444);
    background: rgba(20, 20, 40, 0.85);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan, var(--ssli-accent-cyan));
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 0;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.sslu-master-mute-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(30, 30, 60, 0.95);
    border-color: var(--sslu-cyan, var(--ssli-accent-cyan));
}

.sslu-master-mute-btn.muted {
    background: rgba(60, 20, 20, 0.9);
    border-color: #e07020;
    color: #e07020;
}

.sslu-master-mute-btn.muted:hover {
    background: rgba(80, 30, 20, 0.95);
    border-color: #ff8833;
    color: #ff8833;
}

/* A-12: Remove GPU-expensive backdrop-filter from master mute */
.sslu-master-mute-btn {
    backdrop-filter: none;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
}

/* ========================================
   U-09: Reduced Motion — prefers-reduced-motion
   ======================================== */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    /* Disable BPM pulse animation */
    .sslu-bpm-pulse-bar.pulse {
        animation: none;
    }

    /* Disable key press / sidebar press animations */
    .sidebar-btn.sidebar-pressing {
        transform: none;
        transition: none;
    }

    /* Disable landing page button hover scale */
    .ssli-play-btn:hover,
    .ssli-fullscreen-btn:hover {
        transform: none;
    }

    /* Disable harp pluck animation */
    @keyframes harp-pluck {
        0%, 100% { transform: none; }
    }

    /* Disable glide tip animation */
    .ssl-glide-finger {
        animation: none;
    }

    /* Disable recording blink */
    .ssl-rec-dot {
        animation: none;
    }

    /* Disable onboarding fade-in */
    .ssl-onboarding-tooltip {
        animation: none;
    }

    /* Disable body breathing pulse */
    body.ssl-landing-visible {
        box-shadow: none;
    }

    /* Reduce all transitions to near-instant */
    * {
        transition-duration: 0.01s !important;
    }
}

/* ========================================
   iOS Safe Area + Surface Height Fix
   Prevent bottom-row clipping on iPhone landscape
   ======================================== */

#performKeyboard {
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
}

/* All surface wrappers: ensure flex shrink-to-fit within available viewport */
.ssli-hurdygurdy-wrapper,
.ssli-accordion-wrapper,
.ssli-breathfinger-wrapper,
.ssli-shrutibox-wrapper,
.steelpan-wrapper,
.ctrl-marimba-wrapper,
.ctrl-harp-wrapper,
.ssli-airsynth-wrapper,
.ctrl-theremin-wrapper {
    max-height: 100%;
}

/* Inner flex children of surfaces must shrink, never overflow parent */
.ssli-hurdygurdy-body,
.ssli-accordion-body,
.bf-main-row,
.ssli-shrutibox-reed-area,
.steelpan-body-row {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* ========================================
   Standardized Dropdown (select) Styling
   All <select> elements in SSLI surfaces get a consistent look.
   Height: 28px desktop, 24px phone
   Background: var(--ssli-bg-input)
   Color: var(--ssli-text-primary)
   Border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm)
   Font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body)
   ======================================== */

select {
    height: var(--ssli-dropdown-h, 28px);
    background: var(--ssli-bg-input, #21262d);
    color: var(--ssli-text-primary, rgba(220, 235, 245, 0.95));
    border: 1px solid var(--ssli-border-muted, rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.15));
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm, 3px);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body, 13px);
    font-family: inherit;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
}

select:focus {
    border-color: var(--ssli-accent-cyan, #00d4ff);
}

[data-layout="phone"] select,
[data-layout="phone-land"] select {
    height: var(--ssli-dropdown-h-phone, 24px);
}

/* ========================================
   Standardized Slider (input[type="range"]) Styling
   Track height: 6px (var(--ssli-slider-track-h))
   Thumb size: 18px square with var(--ssli-radius-md) border-radius
   Track background: var(--ssli-bg-input)
   Thumb background: var(--ssli-accent-cyan)
   ======================================== */

input[type="range"] {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    height: var(--ssli-slider-track-h, 6px);
    background: var(--ssli-bg-input, #21262d);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm, 3px);
    outline: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    height: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md, 6px);
    background: var(--ssli-accent-cyan, #00d4ff);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track {
    height: var(--ssli-slider-track-h, 6px);
    background: var(--ssli-bg-input, #21262d);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm, 3px);
    border: none;
}

input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    height: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md, 6px);
    background: var(--ssli-accent-cyan, #00d4ff);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────
   Language Selector — Landing Screen
   ────────────────────────────────────── */
.ssl-lang-selector {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3px 4px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    margin: 8px auto 0;
    padding: 4px 8px;
}

.ssl-lang-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 3px;
    padding: 2px 5px;
    background: rgba(16, 16, 32, 0.6);
    border: 1px solid rgba(120, 120, 180, 0.15);
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #aaaacc;
    font-size: 9px;
    font-family: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    line-height: 1;
}

.ssl-lang-btn svg {
    width: 18px;
    height: 12px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border-radius: 2px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}

.ssl-lang-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(30, 30, 60, 0.8);
    border-color: rgba(120, 120, 220, 0.35);
    color: #ccccee;
}

.ssl-lang-btn.ssl-lang-active {
    background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.12);
    border-color: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.45);
    color: #e0e0ff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.15);
}

.ssl-lang-btn.ssl-lang-active:hover {
    background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.18);
    border-color: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.6);
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────
   Language Selector — iOS Responsive
   ────────────────────────────────────── */

/* 480px = widest phone portrait (iPhone Plus/Max at 428px, with margin) */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .ssl-lang-selector {
        gap: 2px 3px;
        padding: 2px 4px;
        margin: 4px auto 0;
    }
    .ssl-lang-btn {
        padding: 2px 3px;
        gap: 2px;
        font-size: 8px;
        flex-shrink: 1;
        min-width: 0;
    }
    .ssl-lang-btn svg {
        width: 14px;
        height: 10px;
    }
    /* Hide language name on narrow phones — flag only */
    .ssl-lang-btn span {
        display: none;
    }
}

/* 320px = iPhone SE — tightest phone portrait */
@media (max-width: 320px) {
    .ssl-lang-selector {
        gap: 1px 2px;
        padding: 1px 2px;
    }
    .ssl-lang-btn {
        padding: 1px 2px;
    }
    .ssl-lang-btn svg {
        width: 12px;
        height: 8px;
    }
}

/* 400px = phone landscape height (iPhone landscape is 375px) */
/* Flag-only mode: hide language name text to fit 28 buttons in fewer rows */
@media (max-height: 400px) {
    .ssl-lang-selector {
        gap: 2px 3px;
        padding: 2px 4px;
        margin: 4px auto 0;
    }
    .ssl-lang-btn {
        padding: 2px 3px;
        gap: 0;
    }
    /* Hide the language name span, keep only the flag SVG */
    .ssl-lang-btn span {
        display: none;
    }
    .ssl-lang-btn svg {
        width: 20px;
        height: 14px;
    }
}

/* Phone landscape: compact scrollable grid of flags */
@media (max-height: 450px) and (orientation: landscape) {
    .ssl-lang-selector {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        gap: 3px;
        padding: 4px;
        margin: 0;
        max-height: calc(100vh - 20px);
        overflow-y: auto;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        justify-items: center;
    }
    .ssl-lang-btn {
        padding: 3px 4px;
        gap: 0;
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: center;
    }
    /* Hide the language name span, keep only the flag SVG */
    .ssl-lang-btn span {
        display: none;
    }
    .ssl-lang-btn svg {
        width: 22px;
        height: 15px;
    }
}
