/* === quad-layout.css === */
/* ================================================================
   Super Synth Lab Universe - Quad Layout System
   Cross-platform responsive layout: 2x2 grid on desktop,
   single-pane with dot toggle on phone.
   ================================================================ */

/* Responsive tokens now in design-tokens.css */

/* ---- Viewport fix for iOS Safari ---- */
html, body {
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

/* ---- Quad Wrapper (the 2x2 grid container) ---- */
.sslu-quad-wrapper {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-1);
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-recessed);
}

/* ---- Individual Quad ---- */
.sslu-quad {
    overflow: hidden;
    min-height: 0;
    min-width: 0;
    position: relative;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-raised);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-cyan-ghost);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.sslu-quad > * {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    max-width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.sslu-quad-0 { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; } /* TL */
.sslu-quad-1 { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; } /* TR */
.sslu-quad-2 { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; } /* BL */
.sslu-quad-3 { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; } /* BR */

/* ---- Phone portrait: single pane ---- */
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-quad-wrapper {
    display: block;
    height: 100%;
}

[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-quad {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 0;
    padding-bottom: calc(56px + var(--sslu-safe-bottom));
}

/* ---- Phone landscape: single pane (same as portrait) ---- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad-wrapper {
    display: block;
    height: 100%;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 0;
    padding: 0 48px 32px 48px !important;
}

/* ---- Tablet portrait: 2x2 but with more vertical space ---- */
[data-layout="tablet"] .sslu-quad-wrapper {
    gap: var(--sslu-space-3);
}

/* ---- Dot Toggle (phone quad switcher) ---- */
.sslu-dot-toggle {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: calc(var(--sslu-space-6) + var(--sslu-safe-bottom));
    right: var(--sslu-space-6);
    display: none;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
    z-index: var(--sslu-z-dot-toggle);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-3);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-frosted);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-2xl);
    backdrop-filter: var(--sslu-backdrop-blur);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--sslu-backdrop-blur);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-cyan-subtle);
    touch-action: manipulation;
}

[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-dot-toggle,
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot-toggle {
    display: grid;
}

.sslu-dot {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-medium) solid var(--sslu-cyan-muted);
    background: var(--sslu-cyan-ghost);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: background var(--sslu-transition-normal), border-color var(--sslu-transition-normal);
    touch-action: manipulation;
}

.sslu-dot:hover {
    background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.2);
    border-color: var(--sslu-cyan-dim);
}

.sslu-dot.active {
    background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.45);
    border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    box-shadow: var(--sslu-shadow-glow-cyan);
}

/* ---- Row-mode dot toggle (phone-landscape) ---- */
.sslu-dot-toggle.sslu-dot-toggle-rows {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-3);
}

.sslu-dot-row {
    width: 36px;
    height: 12px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

/* ---- Safe Area Padding ---- */
[data-layout="phone"] .ssl-screens,
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssl-screens {
    padding-top: var(--sslu-safe-top);
    padding-left: var(--sslu-safe-left);
    padding-right: var(--sslu-safe-right);
}

/* ---- Global scrollbar hide ---- */
*::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}
* {
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
}

/* ---- CRITICAL: NO SCROLLING on phone layouts ---- */
/* Every quad must fit without overflow. Split content across quads instead. */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad,
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-quad {
    overflow: hidden !important;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-quad *,
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-quad * {
    overflow-y: hidden !important;
}

/* ---- Quad internal scroll helpers ---- */
.sslu-quad-scroll-y {
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.sslu-quad-scroll-x {
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

/* ---- Phone-land: vertical dot toggle on LEFT side, below SSLU button ---- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot-toggle {
    bottom: auto;
    right: auto;
    left: calc(var(--sslu-space-2) + var(--sslu-safe-left));
    top: calc(40px + var(--sslu-safe-top));
    transform: none;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    grid-auto-rows: auto;
    padding: 0;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
    border-radius: 0;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    backdrop-filter: none;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
    pointer-events: auto;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    line-height: 1;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    border: none;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, filter 0.15s ease;
}

/* Candy colors for each dot position */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(1) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b6b, #ee5a24); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(238,90,36,0.4); }
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(2) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #feca57, #ff9f43); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(255,159,67,0.4); }
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(3) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #48dbfb, #0abde3); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(10,189,227,0.4); }
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(4) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a29bfe, #6c5ce7); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(108,92,231,0.4); }
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(5) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #55efc4, #00b894); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,184,148,0.4); }

[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot:active {
    transform: scale(0.9);
    filter: brightness(0.85);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-dot.active {
    transform: scale(1.1);
    filter: brightness(1.15);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.4), 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
}

/* ---- Phone portrait: same left-side vertical layout ---- */
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-dot-toggle {
    bottom: auto;
    right: auto;
    left: calc(var(--sslu-space-2) + var(--sslu-safe-left));
    top: calc(40px + var(--sslu-safe-top));
    transform: none;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    padding: 0;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
    background: none;
    border: none;
    backdrop-filter: none;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
}

[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-dot {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    border: none;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(1) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b6b, #ee5a24); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(238,90,36,0.4); }
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(2) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #feca57, #ff9f43); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(255,159,67,0.4); }
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(3) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #48dbfb, #0abde3); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(10,189,227,0.4); }
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(4) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a29bfe, #6c5ce7); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(108,92,231,0.4); }
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-dot:nth-child(5) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #55efc4, #00b894); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,184,148,0.4); }
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-dot.active {
    transform: scale(1.1);
    filter: brightness(1.15);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.4), 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
}

/* ---- Phone-land: shrink SCOPE button ---- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .analyzer-toggle,
[data-layout="phone"] .analyzer-toggle {
    bottom: var(--sslu-space-2);
    left: var(--sslu-space-2);
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    min-height: 24px;
    min-width: 24px;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-inactive);
}

/* ---- Phone touch target minimums ---- */
[data-layout="phone"] button,
[data-layout="phone"] select,
[data-layout="phone"] input[type="range"],
[data-layout="phone-land"] button,
[data-layout="phone-land"] select,
[data-layout="phone-land"] input[type="range"] {
    min-height: var(--sslu-touch-min);
    min-width: var(--sslu-touch-min);
}

/* ---- Phone tiers: hide persistent sidebar, use hamburger overlay ---- */
[data-layout="phone"] .ssl-sidebar:not(.fullscreen),
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssl-sidebar:not(.fullscreen) {
    display: none !important;
}

[data-layout="phone"] .ssl-sidebar.fullscreen,
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssl-sidebar.fullscreen {
    display: flex;
    position: absolute !important;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    justify-content: flex-start !important;
    padding-top: 8px !important;
    min-height: 100dvh !important;
    min-height: 100vh !important;
    height: auto !important;
}

/* Remove bottom-bar sidebar at small widths (phone uses hamburger now) */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .ssl-sidebar:not(.fullscreen) {
        display: none !important;
    }
    .ssl-screens {
        margin-left: 0 !important;
        margin-bottom: 0 !important;
    }
}

/* ---- Floating SSLU hamburger button (matches candy dot style) ---- */
.sslu-hamburger-btn {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    top: calc(var(--sslu-space-2) + var(--sslu-safe-top));
    left: calc(var(--sslu-space-2) + var(--sslu-safe-left));
    z-index: 9000;
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    min-width: 32px;
    min-height: 32px;
    padding: 0;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    font-weight: 800;
    font-family: inherit;
    color: #fff;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fd79a8, #e84393);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(232,67,147,0.5);
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, filter 0.15s ease;
    line-height: 1;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    letter-spacing: 0;
}

.sslu-hamburger-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.9);
    filter: brightness(0.85);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-hamburger-btn,
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-hamburger-btn {
    display: flex;
}

/* ---- Portrait Rotation Overlay (phone only) ---- */
.sslu-rotate-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    z-index: 99999;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-base);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* Subtle animated gradient background */
.sslu-rotate-overlay::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: -50%;
    width: 200%;
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.03) 0%,
        rgba(114, 9, 183, 0.05) 30%,
        rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.03) 60%,
        rgba(114, 9, 183, 0.05) 100%
    );
    background-size: 200% 200%;
    animation: sslu-rotate-bg-drift 8s ease-in-out infinite;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
}

@keyframes sslu-rotate-bg-drift {
    0%   { background-position: 0% 50%; }
    50%  { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
}

.sslu-rotate-overlay-inner {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-6);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-8);
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.sslu-rotate-icon {
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
    animation: sslu-rotate-nudge 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    font-size: 48px;
}

@keyframes sslu-rotate-nudge {
    0%   { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
    15%  { transform: rotate(-25deg) scale(1.05); }
    50%  { transform: rotate(90deg) scale(1.1); }
    75%  { transform: rotate(85deg) scale(1.05); }
    100% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
}

.sslu-rotate-msg {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-h3);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-wide);
}

.sslu-rotate-sub {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-md);
    color: var(--sslu-text-body);
    max-width: 260px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

/* "Continue in portrait" — proper full-width button */
.sslu-rotate-continue {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 48px;
    padding: var(--sslu-space-4) var(--sslu-space-8);
    margin-top: var(--sslu-space-8);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-lg);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-family);
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    background: var(--sslu-gradient-brand);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-medium) solid var(--sslu-cyan-muted);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xl);
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    line-height: 1.4;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
}

.sslu-rotate-continue:active {
    filter: brightness(0.85);
    transform: scale(0.97);
}

.sslu-quad-header {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-small);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-wide);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan-dim);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-4) var(--sslu-space-1);
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    user-select: none;
}

/* ---- Safe-area padding for fixed bottom-bar elements ---- */
[data-layout="phone"] .analyzer-toggle,
[data-layout="phone-land"] .analyzer-toggle,
[data-layout="phone"] .sslu-fullscreen-btn,
[data-layout="phone-land"] .sslu-fullscreen-btn {
    bottom: calc(var(--sslu-space-2) + var(--sslu-safe-bottom));
}


/* === keyboard.css === */
/**
 * keyboard.css - Keyboard and Isomorphic Grid Styles for Synth Lab
 * Traditional keyboard layout and isomorphic grid controls
 */

/* ========================================
   Keyboard/Isomorphic Row Container
   ======================================== */

.kb-iso-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-lg);
    margin-bottom: var(--sslu-gap-xs);
}

/* ========================================
   Keyboard Section
   ======================================== */

.kb-section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
}

.kb-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.15rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
}

.kb-controls button {
    padding: 0.1rem 0.25rem;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    background: var(--sslu-purple-btn);
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: var(--sslu-touch-min);
    min-height: var(--sslu-touch-min);
    touch-action: manipulation;
}

.kb-controls button:hover {
    background: var(--sslu-cyan);
}

#octRange {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    min-width: 40px;
    text-align: center;
}

/* ========================================
   Keyboard Layout
   ======================================== */

.keyboard {
    display: flex;
    height: 140px;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
    touch-action: none;
}

/* ========================================
   Individual Keys
   ======================================== */

.key {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding-bottom: 2px;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    transition: all var(--sslu-transition-fast);
    position: relative;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* White Keys — dark theme */
.key.white {
    width: var(--sslu-key-white-w);
    height: var(--sslu-key-white-h);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3a50 0%, #2a2a3e 100%);
    border: 1px solid #555;
    border-radius: 0 0 var(--sslu-radius-sm) var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    color: #ccc;
    z-index: var(--sslu-z-keys-white);
    margin: 0 0.5px;
    box-shadow: var(--sslu-shadow-key);
}

/* Black Keys */
.key.black {
    width: var(--sslu-key-black-w);
    height: var(--sslu-key-black-h);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #404040 0%, #1a1a1a 100%);
    border: 1px solid #000;
    border-radius: 0 0 var(--sslu-radius-xs) var(--sslu-radius-xs);
    color: #aaa;
    z-index: var(--sslu-z-keys-black);
    margin: 0 -10px;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    box-shadow: var(--sslu-shadow-key-black);
}

/* Playing State — cyan glow on press with depth effect */
.key.white.playing {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a4a5e 0%, #2a3a4e 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.6), 0 0 16px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.2);
    transform: translateY(2px) rotateX(2deg);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease-out, box-shadow 0.1s ease-out;
}

.key.black.playing {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2a2a2a 0%, #111 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.4), 0 0 12px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.15);
    transform: translateY(2px) rotateX(2deg);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease-out, box-shadow 0.1s ease-out;
}

/* Key Pressed State — brightness boost + cyan glow, 100ms transition */
.key.key-pressed {
    filter: brightness(1.3);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.7), 0 0 20px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.3);
    transition: filter 0.1s ease-out, box-shadow 0.1s ease-out;
}

.key.white.key-pressed {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4a5a6e 0%, #3a4a5e 100%);
}

.key.black.key-pressed {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a3a4a 0%, #1a1a2a 100%);
}

/* Out-of-Scale Keys */
.key.white.out-key {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #252538 0%, #1e1e30 100%);
}

.key.black.out-key {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #777 0%, #555 100%);
}

/* ========================================
   Note Indicators on Keys
   ======================================== */

/* Color dot — decorative, secondary identifier */
.note-dot {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-pill);
    margin-bottom: 1px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0;
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #fff;
    text-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    line-height: 1;
}

/* Note letter label — primary identifier for colorblind accessibility */
.key .note-letter {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-md);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-text-secondary);
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.key.black .note-letter {
    color: #ccc;
}

.oct-stripe {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 3px;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}

/* ========================================
   Note Readout Display
   ======================================== */

.note-readout {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    min-height: 1em;
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
    margin-top: 0.1rem;
}

/* ========================================
   Isomorphic Section
   ======================================== */

.iso-section {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-widget);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    padding: 0.3rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-widget);
}

.iso-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
}

.iso-title {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
}

.iso-header select {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
    background: var(--sslu-purple);
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.iso-header select:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.1);
}

/* ========================================
   Isomorphic Grid
   ======================================== */

.iso-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}

.iso-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}

/* ========================================
   Isomorphic Keys
   ======================================== */

.iso-key {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all var(--sslu-transition-fast);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    box-shadow: var(--sslu-shadow-sm);
    position: relative;
}

/* Hexagonal Layout — tessellated hexagons, no gaps
   Hex orientation: points left/right, flat top/bottom
   W = 44px, H = W * sqrt(3)/2 = 38px
   Horizontal center-to-center = W * 0.75 = 33px
   Vertical center-to-center = H / 2 = 19px
   Odd-row offset = 33 / 2 = 16.5px */
.iso-key.hex {
    width: 44px;
    height: 38px;
    clip-path: polygon(25% 0%, 75% 0%, 100% 50%, 75% 100%, 25% 100%, 0% 50%);
    border-radius: 0;
    margin: 0 -5.5px;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-xs);
    border: none;
    box-shadow: none;
    filter: brightness(1) drop-shadow(0 0 0.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.5));
}

.iso-key.hex:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.3) drop-shadow(0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.4));
}

/* Hex container must override the iso-grid gap */
.iso-grid.hex-grid {
    gap: 0;
}

/* Hex rows use position:relative for z-stacking */
.iso-row.hex-row {
    gap: 0;
    margin-bottom: -19px;
    position: relative;
}

.iso-row.hex-row-odd {
    margin-left: 16.5px;
}

.iso-row.hex-row:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* Out-of-Scale */
.iso-key.out-key {
    background: #666 !important;
    color: #999;
}

/* Playing State */
.iso-key.playing {
    transform: scale(0.9);
    box-shadow: none;
    filter: brightness(0.7);
}

/* Root Note Highlight */
.iso-key.root {
    box-shadow: 0 0 3px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

/* Octave Indicator Dot */
.iso-key .oct-dot {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 1px;
    right: 1px;
    width: 4px;
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}


/* === controls.css === */
/**
 * controls.css - ADSR and Oscillator Mixer Styles for Synth Lab
 * Faders, ADSR envelope controls, and oscillator mixing panel
 */

/* ========================================
   Global Checkbox Styling (catch-all)
   ======================================== */

input[type="checkbox"] {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    min-width: 24px;
    min-height: 24px;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-elevated, #1a1a2e);
    border: 2px solid var(--sslu-border-default, rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.15));
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm, 4px);
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    vertical-align: middle;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

input[type="checkbox"]:checked {
    background: var(--sslu-accent-primary, #7c3aed);
    border-color: var(--sslu-accent-primary, #7c3aed);
}

input[type="checkbox"]:checked::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(50% - 9px);
    left: calc(50% - 4px);
    width: 10px;
    height: 14px;
    border: solid #fff;
    border-width: 0 3px 3px 0;
    transform: rotate(45deg);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    min-width: 32px;
    min-height: 32px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] input[type="checkbox"]:checked::after {
    top: calc(50% - 12px);
    left: calc(50% - 5px);
    width: 14px;
    height: 18px;
    border-width: 0 3.5px 3.5px 0;
}

/* ========================================
   ADSR Panel
   ======================================== */

.adsr-panel {
    display: none;  /* Hidden - moved to MIXER modal */
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding: 0.2rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    align-items: flex-end;
}

.adsr-fader {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.1rem;
}

/* ========================================
   Fader Base Styles
   ======================================== */

.fader {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 12px;
    height: 70px;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    writing-mode: vertical-lr;
    direction: rtl;
}

.fader::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    width: 6px;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

.fader::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 14px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xs);
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-left: -4px;
}

.fader::-moz-range-track {
    width: 6px;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

.fader::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 14px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xs);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

/* ========================================
   Attack Fader (.fader-a)
   V-07: Changed from red (#ff6b6b) to orange (#ff9f43)
   for deuteranopia safety (red/green indistinguishable)
   ======================================== */

.fader-a::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff9f43, #cc7a20);
}

.fader-a::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    background: #ff9f43;
    border: 1px solid #fff;
}

.fader-a::-moz-range-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff9f43, #cc7a20);
}

.fader-a::-moz-range-thumb {
    background: #ff9f43;
}

/* ========================================
   Decay Fader (.fader-d)
   ======================================== */

.fader-d::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffd93d, #f59f00);
}

.fader-d::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    background: #ffd93d;
    border: 1px solid #fff;
}

.fader-d::-moz-range-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffd93d, #f59f00);
}

.fader-d::-moz-range-thumb {
    background: #ffd93d;
}

/* ========================================
   Sustain Fader (.fader-s)
   V-07: Changed from green (#6bcb77) to blue (#4d96ff)
   for deuteranopia safety (red/green indistinguishable)
   ======================================== */

.fader-s::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4d96ff, #2d6fd0);
}

.fader-s::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    background: #4d96ff;
    border: 1px solid #fff;
}

.fader-s::-moz-range-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4d96ff, #2d6fd0);
}

.fader-s::-moz-range-thumb {
    background: #4d96ff;
}

/* ========================================
   Release Fader (.fader-r)
   ======================================== */

.fader-r::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4d96ff, #1971c2);
}

.fader-r::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    background: #4d96ff;
    border: 1px solid #fff;
}

.fader-r::-moz-range-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4d96ff, #1971c2);
}

.fader-r::-moz-range-thumb {
    background: #4d96ff;
}

/* ========================================
   Fader Value and Label
   ======================================== */

.fader-val {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #aaa;
    min-width: 22px;
    text-align: center;
}

.fader-lbl {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
}

/* Colored Labels Based on Preceding Fader */
.fader-a + .fader-val + .fader-lbl {
    color: #ff6b6b;
}

.fader-d + .fader-val + .fader-lbl {
    color: #ffd93d;
}

.fader-s + .fader-val + .fader-lbl {
    color: #6bcb77;
}

.fader-r + .fader-val + .fader-lbl {
    color: #4d96ff;
}

/* ========================================
   Oscillator Mixer Panel
   ======================================== */

.osc-mixer {
    display: none;  /* Hidden - use MIXER button modal instead */
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.15rem;
    padding: 0.2rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
}

.mixer-title {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: var(--sslu-rose, #f72585);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    text-align: center;
}

.osc-strips {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.25rem;
}

/* ========================================
   Oscillator Strip
   ======================================== */

.osc-strip {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.08rem;
    padding: 0.1rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    min-width: 32px;
}

.osc-num {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #4cc9f0;
}

/* ========================================
   Oscillator Controls
   ======================================== */

.osc-wave,
.osc-oct {
    padding: 0.04rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: #2a2a4e;
    color: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #444;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xs);
    width: 36px;
}

.osc-detune {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 36px;
    height: 6px;
    background: #333;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.osc-detune::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 8px;
    height: 12px;
    background: #7209b7;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xs);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.osc-detune::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 8px;
    height: 12px;
    background: #7209b7;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xs);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.osc-detune-val,
.osc-level-val {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #888;
    text-align: center;
}

/* ========================================
   Oscillator 1 Level Fader
   ======================================== */

.fader-osc1::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f72585, #b5179e);
}

.fader-osc1::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    background: #f72585;
    border: 1px solid #fff;
}

.fader-osc1::-moz-range-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f72585, #b5179e);
}

.fader-osc1::-moz-range-thumb {
    background: #f72585;
}

/* ========================================
   Oscillator 2 Level Fader
   ======================================== */

.fader-osc2::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #7209b7, #560bad);
}

.fader-osc2::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    background: #7209b7;
    border: 1px solid #fff;
}

.fader-osc2::-moz-range-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #7209b7, #560bad);
}

.fader-osc2::-moz-range-thumb {
    background: #7209b7;
}

/* ========================================
   Oscillator 3 Level Fader
   ======================================== */

.fader-osc3::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a0ca3, #240046);
}

.fader-osc3::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    background: #3a0ca3;
    border: 1px solid #fff;
}

.fader-osc3::-moz-range-track {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a0ca3, #240046);
}

.fader-osc3::-moz-range-thumb {
    background: #3a0ca3;
}

/* ========================================
   MIXER Button
   ======================================== */

.mixer-btn {
    padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f72585, #7209b7);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.mixer-btn:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.2);
}

.mixer-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.98);
}

/* ========================================
   Clear Instrument Buttons
   ======================================== */

.clear-inst-btn,
.clear-all-inst-btn {
    padding: 0.12rem 0.35rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
}

.clear-inst-btn {
    background: #c0392b;
}

.clear-inst-btn:hover {
    background: #e74c3c;
}

.clear-all-inst-btn {
    background: #7f1d1d;
}

.clear-all-inst-btn:hover {
    background: #991b1b;
}

.clear-inst-btn:active,
.clear-all-inst-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.95);
}

/* ========================================
   Mixer Modal
   ======================================== */

.mixer-modal {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 300;
}

.mixer-modal.hidden {
    display: none;
}

.mixer-modal-content {
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border: 2px solid #f72585;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xl);
    padding: 1rem;
    min-width: 320px;
    max-width: 90vw;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.3);
}

.mixer-modal-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.5rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.3);
}

.mixer-modal-title {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: var(--sslu-rose, #f72585);
}

.mixer-close {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: #888;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-h3);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    line-height: 1;
}

.mixer-close:hover {
    color: #fff;
}

/* ========================================
   Expanded Oscillator Mixer in Modal
   ======================================== */

.osc-mixer-expanded {
    padding: 0.5rem 0;
}

.osc-mixer-expanded .osc-strips {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    justify-content: center;
}

.osc-strip-lg {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    min-width: 90px;
}

.osc-num-lg {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #4cc9f0;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.osc-strip-lg label {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.15rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #ccc;
}

.osc-strip-lg select,
.osc-wave-lg,
.osc-oct-lg {
    padding: 0.15rem 0.2rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: #2a2a4e;
    color: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #444;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    width: 100%;
}

.osc-strip-lg input[type="range"] {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
    background: #333;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.osc-strip-lg input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    background: #7209b7;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.osc-strip-lg input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    background: #7209b7;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.osc-detune-val-lg,
.osc-level-val-lg {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #aaa;
    text-align: center;
}

/* ========================================
   Modal Sections Container
   ======================================== */

.mixer-sections {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 1rem;
}

/* ========================================
   ADSR Section in Modal
   ======================================== */

.adsr-section-modal {
    padding: 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
}

.adsr-title-modal,
.osc-title-modal {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #4cc9f0;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    text-align: center;
}

.adsr-controls-modal {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.adsr-fader-modal {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.2rem;
}

.adsr-lbl-modal {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-rose, #f72585);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}

/* Colorblind-friendly ADSR envelope shape icons (Fix 17) */
.adsr-lbl-modal::before {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    line-height: 1;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}

.adsr-lbl-modal[data-adsr="A"]::before { content: "\25B2"; } /* ramp up triangle */
.adsr-lbl-modal[data-adsr="D"]::before { content: "\25BD"; } /* ramp down triangle */
.adsr-lbl-modal[data-adsr="S"]::before { content: "\2501"; } /* horizontal line */
.adsr-lbl-modal[data-adsr="R"]::before { content: "\25BF"; } /* small ramp down */

.adsr-slider-modal {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 96px;
    height: 10px;
    background: #444;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.adsr-slider-modal::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    background: #f72585;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.adsr-slider-modal::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    background: #f72585;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.adsr-val-modal {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: #ddd;
}

/* ========================================
   Octave Radio Buttons in Modal
   ======================================== */

.osc-oct-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.2rem;
}

.osc-oct-lbl {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #ccc;
}

.osc-oct-radio {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.15rem;
}

.osc-oct-radio label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: #ddd;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.15rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    transition: all 0.1s;
}

.osc-oct-radio label:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.osc-oct-radio input[type="radio"] {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    border: 2px solid #666;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 0;
}

.osc-oct-radio input[type="radio"]:checked {
    border-color: #f72585;
    background: #f72585;
}

/* ========================================
   Debug Console Panel
   ======================================== */

.debug-panel {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    height: 120px;
    background: #0a0a12;
    border-top: 2px solid #f72585;
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    z-index: 400;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.debug-panel.hidden {
    display: none;
}

.debug-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0.15rem 0.3rem;
    background: #1a1a2e;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
}

.debug-title {
    color: var(--sslu-rose, #f72585);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
}

.debug-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.3rem;
}

.debug-btn {
    padding: 0.1rem 0.2rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: #333;
    color: #ccc;
    border: 1px solid #555;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xs);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.debug-btn:hover {
    background: #444;
    color: #fff;
}

.debug-output {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.debug-line {
    color: #8f8;
    padding: 0.05rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    word-wrap: break-word;
}

.debug-line.error {
    color: #f66;
}

.debug-line.warn {
    color: #fd0;
}

.debug-toggle {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    padding: 0.15rem 0.3rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f72585, #7209b7);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    z-index: 401;
    display: none; /* Hidden in production — enable via JS for debug */
}

.debug-toggle:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.2);
}

/* Phone-land: compact and semi-transparent to reduce content clipping */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .debug-toggle {
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    min-height: 24px;
    min-width: 24px;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-overlay);
    bottom: 2px;
    right: 10px;
}

.debug-panel:not(.hidden) ~ .debug-toggle {
    bottom: 130px;
}

/* ========================================
   Filter Section in Modal
   ======================================== */

.filter-section-modal {
    padding: 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.filter-header-modal {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.filter-title-modal {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #4cc9f0;
}

.filter-enable-modal {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #fff;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.filter-enable-modal input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* Mode + Slope combined row */
.filter-mode-slope-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #eee;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.filter-row-label {
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: #fff;
}

.filter-slope-label {
    margin-left: 0.5rem;
}

.filter-type-radios,
.filter-slope-radios,
.filter-freq-unit-radios {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.25rem;
}

.filter-type-radios label,
.filter-slope-radios label,
.filter-freq-unit-radios label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.15rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.12rem 0.2rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    transition: all 0.1s;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #fff;
}

.filter-type-radios label:hover,
.filter-slope-radios label:hover,
.filter-freq-unit-radios label:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.filter-type-radios input[type="radio"],
.filter-slope-radios input[type="radio"],
.filter-freq-unit-radios input[type="radio"] {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border: 2px solid #666;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 0;
}

.filter-type-radios input[type="radio"]:checked {
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
    background: #4cc9f0;
}

.filter-slope-radios input[type="radio"]:checked {
    border-color: #f72585;
    background: #f72585;
}

.filter-freq-unit-radios input[type="radio"]:checked {
    border-color: #7209b7;
    background: #7209b7;
}

.filter-model-row {
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.filter-model-row label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #fff;
}

.filter-model-row select {
    padding: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: #2a2a4e;
    color: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #555;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

.filter-freq-row,
.filter-q-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #fff;
}

.filter-freq-value,
.filter-q-value {
    font-family: monospace;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #4cc9f0;
    min-width: 80px;
    text-align: right;
    margin-left: auto;
}

.filter-freq-lg {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #240046, #4cc9f0);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
