}

.effect-chain-icon {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-md);
}

.effect-chain-name {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: #ccc;
    min-width: 55px;
}

.effect-chain-enable {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.effect-chain-enable input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.effect-chain-btn {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    color: #888;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    padding: 0.15rem 0.3rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    line-height: 1;
}

.effect-chain-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(114, 9, 183, 0.3);
    border-color: rgba(114, 9, 183, 0.5);
    color: #fff;
}

.effect-chain-btn:active {
    background: rgba(114, 9, 183, 0.5);
}

/* ========================================
   Effects Parameters Section
   ======================================== */

.effects-params-section {
    padding: 0.5rem 0;
}

.effects-params-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

/* ========================================
   Individual Effect Panel
   ======================================== */

.effect-panel {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    padding: 0.4rem;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-inactive);
    transition: all 0.2s;
    width: 180px;
    min-width: 180px;
    max-width: 180px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.effect-panel.enabled {
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
    border-color: rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.3);
    background: rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.05);
}

.effect-panel-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.effect-panel-icon {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-lg);
}

.effect-panel-title {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
}

.effect-panel.enabled .effect-panel-title {
    color: var(--sslu-rose);
}

/* ========================================
   Effect Parameter Controls
   ======================================== */

.effect-panel-params {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.35rem;
}

.effect-param-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 55px 1fr 45px;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.4rem;
}

.effect-param-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #aaa;
    text-align: right;
}

.effect-param-slider {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: var(--ssli-slider-track-h, 6px);
    background: var(--ssli-bg-input, #21262d);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm, 3px);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.effect-param-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    height: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    background: var(--ssli-accent-cyan, #00d4ff);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md, 6px);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    transition: background 0.15s;
}

.effect-param-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover {
    background: var(--sslu-rose);
}

.effect-param-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    height: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    background: var(--ssli-accent-cyan, #00d4ff);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md, 6px);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.effect-param-slider::-moz-range-thumb:hover {
    background: var(--sslu-rose);
}

.effect-param-value {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #ccc;
    text-align: left;
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-mono);
}

.effect-param-select {
    padding: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
    color: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.effect-param-select:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--sslu-purple);
}

/* ========================================
   Effects Tab Content
   ======================================== */

#effectsTabContent {
    max-height: 60vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding-right: 0.25rem;
}

/* Hide disabled effect panels */
.effect-panel.hidden {
    display: none;
}

#effectsTabContent::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 6px;
}

#effectsTabContent::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

#effectsTabContent::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.3);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

#effectsTabContent::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: rgba(247, 37, 133, 0.5);
}

/* ========================================
   Tab Content Visibility
   ======================================== */

.effects-tab-content {
    display: block;
}

.effects-tab-content.hidden {
    display: none;
}

/* ========================================
   Master Effects Mix Control
   ======================================== */

.effects-master-section {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
    padding: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.3);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
}

.effects-master-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.effects-master-slider {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    flex: 1;
    height: 8px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, #333 0%, #7209b7 100%);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.effects-master-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    background: var(--sslu-cyan);
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.5);
}

.effects-master-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    background: var(--sslu-cyan);
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.effects-master-value {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    min-width: 45px;
    text-align: right;
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-mono);
}

/* ========================================
   Effect Instrument Tabs
   ======================================== */

.effects-inst-tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
}

.effects-inst-tab {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    color: #888;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
}

.effects-inst-tab:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: #ccc;
}

.effects-inst-tab.active {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.3), rgba(114, 9, 183, 0.3));
    border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    color: #fff;
}

/* Per-instrument color coding */
.effects-inst-tab.active[data-target="0"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76,201,240,0.3), rgba(76,201,240,0.1));
    border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
}
.effects-inst-tab.active[data-target="1"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(45,212,191,0.3), rgba(45,212,191,0.1));
    border-color: #2dd4bf;
}
.effects-inst-tab.active[data-target="2"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,158,11,0.3), rgba(245,158,11,0.1));
    border-color: #f59e0b;
}
.effects-inst-tab.active[data-target="3"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.3), rgba(167,139,250,0.1));
    border-color: #a78bfa;
}
.effects-master-tab.active {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(247,37,133,0.3), rgba(247,37,133,0.1));
    border-color: var(--sslu-rose);
}


/* === effects-screen.css === */
/**
 * effects-screen.css - EFFECTS screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Overhauled layout: instrument tabs, master mix, card grid
 */

/* ========================================
   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

#screen-effects {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
    overflow-y: auto;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-base);
}

/* ========================================
   Instrument Tabs
   ======================================== */

.effects-inst-tabs-bar {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-sm);
    padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-raised);
    border-bottom: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
}

.effects-inst-tab-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 0.35rem var(--sslu-gap-lg);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h4);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-widget);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    color: #888;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all var(--sslu-transition-normal);
    text-align: center;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.effects-inst-tab-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: #ccc;
}

.effects-inst-tab-btn.active {
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
}

/* Per-instrument color coding */
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="0"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76,201,240,0.3), rgba(76,201,240,0.1));
    border-color: var(--sslu-inst-0);
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="1"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(45,212,191,0.3), rgba(45,212,191,0.1));
    border-color: var(--sslu-inst-1);
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="2"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,158,11,0.3), rgba(245,158,11,0.1));
    border-color: var(--sslu-inst-2);
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="3"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.3), rgba(167,139,250,0.1));
    border-color: var(--sslu-inst-3);
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="4"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(247,37,133,0.3), rgba(247,37,133,0.1));
    border-color: var(--sslu-inst-master);
}
.effects-inst-tab-btn.active[data-inst="master"] {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15), rgba(255,255,255,0.05));
    border-color: #ccc;
}

.effects-bypass-btn {
    padding: var(--sslu-gap-sm) 0.7rem;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h4);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #ccc;
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-left: var(--sslu-gap-lg);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: all var(--sslu-transition-normal);
}

.effects-bypass-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--sslu-danger-text);
}

.effects-bypass-btn.active {
    background: #ff4444;
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    border-color: var(--sslu-danger-text);
}

/* ========================================
   Master Mix Bar
   ======================================== */

.effects-master-mix-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-xl);
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-panel) 0.8rem;
    margin: var(--sslu-gap-md) var(--sslu-gap-xl) 0;
    background: var(--sslu-cyan-ghost);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-cyan-subtle);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.effects-master-mix-label {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h2);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.effects-master-mix-slider {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    flex: 1;
    height: var(--sslu-slider-master-track-h);
    background: linear-gradient(to right, #333 0%, var(--sslu-cyan) 100%);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
}

.effects-master-mix-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: var(--sslu-slider-master-thumb);
    height: var(--sslu-slider-master-thumb);
    background: var(--sslu-cyan);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-pill);
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.5);
}

.effects-master-mix-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: var(--sslu-slider-master-thumb);
    height: var(--sslu-slider-master-thumb);
    background: var(--sslu-cyan);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-pill);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.effects-master-mix-value {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h3);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    min-width: 45px;
    text-align: right;
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-mono);
}

/* ========================================
   Effect List — flex-wrap layout
   Enabled effects: full-width rows with params
   Disabled effects: compact inline chips
   ======================================== */

.effects-list {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: var(--sslu-space-4) var(--sslu-space-6);
    scrollbar-width: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
    align-content: flex-start;
}

.effects-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Enabled effect: full-width row with params --- */
.effects-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: rgba(16, 16, 32, 0.5);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-4) var(--sslu-space-6);
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-inactive);
    transition: opacity var(--sslu-transition-normal), border-color var(--sslu-transition-normal);
    width: 100%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.effects-row.enabled {
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
    border-color: var(--sslu-indigo-dim);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--sslu-indigo, #7209b7);
    background: rgba(114, 9, 183, 0.1);
    width: 100%;
    order: -1;
    transition: opacity var(--sslu-transition-normal), border-color var(--sslu-transition-normal), background 0.1s ease;
}

/* --- Disabled effect: compact chip --- */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) {
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    width: auto;
    padding: var(--sslu-space-1) var(--sslu-space-4);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-3xl);
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
}

.effects-row-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-4);
}

/* Compact header in disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-header {
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
}

.effects-row-toggle {
    min-width: var(--sslu-touch-min);
    min-height: var(--sslu-touch-min);
    accent-color: var(--sslu-indigo);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

/* Checked toggle: bright fill + scale pop */
.effects-row-toggle:checked {
    accent-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
}

@keyframes efx-toggle-pop {
    0%   { transform: scale(1); }
    50%  { transform: scale(1.2); }
    100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

.effects-row-toggle.efx-pop {
    animation: efx-toggle-pop 0.1s ease-out;
}

/* Smaller checkbox in disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-toggle {
    min-width: 28px;
    min-height: 28px;
}

.effects-row-icon {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-icon);
}

/* Smaller icon in disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-icon {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-lg);
}

.effects-row-name {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-lg);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
    color: #ccccee;
    flex: 1;
}

/* Smaller name in disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-name {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    flex: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.effects-row-move {
    background: none;
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid #3a3a5a;
    color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-input);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.effects-row-move:hover {
    border-color: var(--sslu-indigo);
    color: #ccccee;
}

/* Hide move buttons on disabled chips */
.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-move {
    display: none;
}

.effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-params {
  display: none;
}

.effects-row-params {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-4);
    margin-top: var(--sslu-space-3);
    padding-left: 28px;
}

.effects-row-param {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
    min-width: 180px;
}

.effects-row-param-label {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
    min-width: 50px;
}

.effects-row-param-slider {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 100px;
    height: var(--sslu-slider-track-h);
    background: var(--sslu-slider-track-bg);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    accent-color: var(--sslu-indigo);
}

.effects-row-param-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: var(--sslu-slider-thumb-w);
    height: var(--sslu-slider-thumb-h);
    background: var(--sslu-indigo);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-pill);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.effects-row-param-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: var(--sslu-slider-thumb-w);
    height: var(--sslu-slider-thumb-h);
    background: var(--sslu-indigo);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-pill);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
}

.effects-row-param-value {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
    color: #aaaacc;
    min-width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-mono);
}

/* Keep effects-add-select and effects-add-btn for phrase looper controls */
.effects-add-select {
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 220px;
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-4);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h4);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #ccc;
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
}

.effects-add-btn {
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-6);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h4);
    background: #2a6;
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid #3b7;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
}

.effects-add-btn:hover {
    background: #3b7;
}

/* ========================================
   Bottom Bar
   ======================================== */

.effects-screen-bottom-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-lg);
    padding: 0.35rem 0.6rem;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-raised);
    border-top: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    min-height: 32px;
}

.effects-test-btn,
.effects-ab-btn {
    padding: var(--sslu-gap-sm) 0.8rem;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h3);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #ccc;
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
    transition: all var(--sslu-transition-normal);
}

.effects-test-btn:hover {
    background: #2a3a5a;
    border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
}

.effects-ab-btn.active {
    background: #4a2a00;
    border-color: var(--sslu-warning);
    color: var(--sslu-warning);
}

.effects-screen-empty {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex: 1;
    color: var(--ssli-text-muted, rgba(220,235,245,0.50));
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h2);
    font-style: italic;
}

/* ========================================
   303 Phrase Looper
   ======================================== */

.fx-phrase-section {
    margin: var(--sslu-gap-lg) var(--sslu-gap-xl);
    padding-top: var(--sslu-gap-lg);
    border-top: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.fx-phrase-section h4 {
    margin-top: 0;
    color: var(--sslu-text-body);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h2);
}

.fx-phrase-transport {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-lg);
    margin-bottom: var(--sslu-gap-md);
}

.fx-phrase-play-btn {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-pill);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thick) solid var(--sslu-inst-3);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: var(--sslu-inst-3);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-lg);
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.fx-phrase-play-btn:hover {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-highlight);
}

.fx-phrase-play-btn.playing {
    background: var(--sslu-inst-3);
    color: #000;
}

.fx-phrase-grid {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-1);
    margin-bottom: var(--sslu-gap-md);
}

.fx-phrase-step {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-1);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-1) 1px;
    background: #12122a;
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid #1a1a3a;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 0;
    transition: border-color 0.1s, background 0.1s;
}

.fx-phrase-step.active {
    border-color: var(--sslu-inst-3);
    background: #2a1a4a;
}

.fx-phrase-step .fx-phrase-note {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body);
    color: var(--sslu-text-body);
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-mono);
    white-space: nowrap;
    user-select: none;
}

.fx-phrase-step.rest .fx-phrase-note {
    color: var(--sslu-text-faint);
}

.fx-phrase-accent,
.fx-phrase-slide {
    width: 18px;
    height: 16px;
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid #333;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xs);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ssli-text-muted, rgba(220,235,245,0.50));
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-small);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.fx-phrase-accent:hover,
.fx-phrase-slide:hover {
    border-color: var(--sslu-text-faint);
}

.fx-phrase-accent.on {
    background: #cc4400;
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    border-color: #ff6600;
}

.fx-phrase-slide.on {
    background: #6633cc;
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    border-color: #8855ff;
}

.fx-phrase-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-md);
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: var(--sslu-gap-md);
}

/* ========================================
   Quad-fill enhancements
   ======================================== */

.sslu-quad #screen-effects {
    height: 100%;
}

.sslu-quad .effects-list {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    min-height: 0;
    align-content: flex-start;
}

.sslu-quad .effects-row.enabled {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 60px;
}

.sslu-quad .effects-master-mix-bar {
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sslu-quad .effects-inst-tabs-bar {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 100%;
}

/* ========================================
   Phone overrides
   ======================================== */

[data-layout="phone"] .effects-row {
    min-height: 48px;
}

[data-layout="phone"] .effects-row-toggle {
    min-width: var(--sslu-touch-min);
    min-height: var(--sslu-touch-min);
}

[data-layout="phone"] .effects-inst-tab-btn {
    padding: var(--sslu-gap-lg) var(--sslu-gap-sm);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body-sm);
}

/* ========================================
   Phone Landscape overrides (844x390)
   Single-pane mode, ~350px usable height
   ======================================== */

/* --- Tab bar: compact 28px --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-inst-tabs-bar {
    padding: 2px 0.4rem;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-1);
    min-height: 28px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-inst-tab-btn {
    padding: 3px var(--sslu-gap-sm);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-sm);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-bypass-btn {
    padding: 2px 0.5rem;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-sm);
    margin-left: var(--sslu-gap-sm);
}

/* --- Effect list: multi-column grid, fill quad height --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-list {
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-4);
    gap: var(--sslu-space-1);
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    align-content: space-evenly;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

/* --- Disabled effect chips: 3-column grid, taller for touch --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row:not(.enabled) {
    width: calc(33.333% - 2px);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-3);
    min-height: 38px;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-toggle {
    min-width: 22px;
    min-height: 22px;
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-icon {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-name {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row:not(.enabled) .effects-row-header {
    gap: var(--sslu-space-1);
}

/* --- Enabled effect rows: full-width, compact --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row.enabled {
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-4);
    min-height: auto;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row.enabled .effects-row-toggle {
    min-width: 22px;
    min-height: 22px;
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row.enabled .effects-row-icon {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row.enabled .effects-row-name {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row-header {
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row-move {
    padding: 1px 4px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}

/* --- Effect params: HIDDEN on phone-land (moved to Q4 detail quad) --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row-params {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Active Params detail quad (Q4) --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-active-params {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-3);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-3) var(--sslu-space-4);
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-active-params-title {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #aaaacc;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-wider);
    padding-bottom: var(--sslu-space-1);
    border-bottom: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid #222;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-detail-group {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-3);
    background: #0f0f1e;
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-subtle);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-detail-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #ccddcc;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-detail-sliders {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-detail-param {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
    flex: 1 1 45%;
    min-width: 140px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-detail-param-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    color: #aaa;
    min-width: 36px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-detail-empty {
    color: var(--ssli-text-muted, rgba(220,235,245,0.50));
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    text-align: center;
    padding: 20px;
}

/* Desktop: show params inline, hide detail quad content */
.effects-active-params {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-3);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-3) var(--sslu-space-4);
}

/* Fallback for non-phone-land: params shown inline */
.effects-row-params {
    margin-top: var(--sslu-space-1);
    padding-left: var(--sslu-space-4);
    gap: var(--sslu-space-2);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row-param {
    min-width: 140px;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-1);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row-param-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    min-width: 36px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row-param-slider {
    width: 80px;
    height: 4px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row-param-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row-param-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-row-param-value {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    min-width: 30px;
}

/* --- Master mix bar: compact --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-master-mix-bar {
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) 0.6rem;
    margin: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-4) 0;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-sm);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-master-mix-label {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-master-mix-slider {
    height: 4px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-master-mix-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-master-mix-slider::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-master-mix-value {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-sm);
    min-width: 35px;
}

/* --- Bottom bar: compact --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-screen-bottom-bar {
    padding: 1px 0.4rem;
    min-height: 22px;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-sm);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-test-btn,
[data-layout="phone-land"] .effects-ab-btn {
    padding: 1px 0.5rem;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-sm);
}

/* --- Effects Q2: clip phrase looper overflow at 220px viewport --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-effects .sslu-quad-2 {
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* --- Phrase looper: hide on phone-land (available on Design screen) --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-section {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Hide the "303 Phrase Looper" title to save ~24px */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-section h4 {
    display: none;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-play-btn {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-transport {
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-grid {
    margin-bottom: 0;
    gap: 0;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-step {
    padding: 0 1px;
    gap: 0;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-step .fx-phrase-note {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-accent,
[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-slide {
    width: 12px;
    height: 10px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-controls {
    margin-bottom: 0;
    gap: var(--sslu-space-1);
}

/* Effects Q2: compact the bottom bar inside Q2 */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-effects .sslu-quad-2 .effects-screen-bottom-bar {
    padding: 0 0.3rem;
    min-height: 18px;
}

/* Effects Q2: compact the phrase controls buttons */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .fx-phrase-controls .effects-add-btn {
    padding: 1px 4px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}

/* Effects Q2: compact transport/nav bar appended to tools quad */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-effects .sslu-quad-2 > div[style*="padding"] {
    padding: 1px 4px !important;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs) !important;
}

/* ========================================
   Category Headers
   ======================================== */

/* Category divider headers — clear separation between effect groups */
.effects-cat-header {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-md);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-widest);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-4) var(--sslu-space-4) var(--sslu-space-2);
    margin-top: var(--sslu-space-4);
    border-top: var(--sslu-border-w-thick) solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.25);
    width: 100%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.04) 0%, transparent 100%);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm) var(--sslu-radius-sm) 0 0;
}

.effects-cat-header:first-child {
    border-top: none;
    margin-top: 0;
}


/* === analyzer.css === */
/* Analyzer Toggle Button */
.analyzer-toggle {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--sslu-space-5);
  left: var(--sslu-space-5);
  padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem;
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
  background: var(--sslu-gradient-brand);
  color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  z-index: var(--sslu-z-analyzer);
  font-family: var(--sslu-font-family);
  min-width: var(--sslu-touch-min);
  min-height: var(--sslu-touch-min);
  touch-action: manipulation;
}

.analyzer-toggle:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.2);
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
}

/* Auto-fade SCOPE button after 5s of inactivity */
@keyframes sslu-scope-fade {
  0%   { opacity: 1; }
  80%  { opacity: 1; }
  100% { opacity: 0.25; }
}

.analyzer-toggle {
  animation: sslu-scope-fade 5s ease-out forwards;
}

.analyzer-toggle:hover,
.analyzer-toggle:focus {
  animation: none;
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
}

/* Reduce opacity on Kids/Calm screens */
#screen-kids .analyzer-toggle,
#screen-calm .analyzer-toggle,
.ssl-screen[data-screen="kids"] ~ .analyzer-toggle,
.ssl-screen[data-screen="calm"] ~ .analyzer-toggle {
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-overlay);
}

/* Analyzer Panel */
.analyzer-panel {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 40px;
  left: var(--sslu-space-5);
  right: var(--sslu-space-5);
  height: 280px;
  background: rgba(26, 26, 46, 0.95);
  border: var(--sslu-border-w-thick) solid var(--sslu-cyan);
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xl);
  z-index: var(--sslu-z-overlay);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--sslu-space-4);
  padding: var(--sslu-space-5);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

.analyzer-panel.hidden {
  display: none;
}

/* On phone layouts, hide analyzer controls entirely to prevent
   iOS <select> picker wheels from covering the keyboard */
[data-layout="phone"] .analyzer-panel,
[data-layout="phone-land"] .analyzer-panel {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Canvas Containers */
.analyzer-section {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}

.analyzer-label {
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
  color: var(--sslu-cyan);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-wider);
  margin-bottom: var(--sslu-space-2);
  font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-medium);
}

.analyzer-canvas {
  flex: 1;
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
  border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
}

/* Close Button */
.analyzer-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 5px;
  right: 8px;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-lg);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: var(--sslu-space-1) var(--sslu-space-3);
}

.analyzer-close:hover {
  color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
}

/* Analyzer Controls Row */
.analyzer-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sslu-space-4);
  margin-bottom: var(--sslu-space-2);
}

.analyzer-controls label {
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
  color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.analyzer-controls select {
  background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
  color: var(--sslu-text-secondary);
  border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
  padding: var(--sslu-pad-input);
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
  font-family: var(--sslu-font-family);
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
}

.analyzer-controls select:hover {
  border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
}

.analyzer-controls select:focus {
  border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
  box-shadow: var(--sslu-shadow-glow-cyan);
}

.analyzer-mode-btn {
  background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
  color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
  border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
  padding: var(--sslu-pad-btn);
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
  font-family: var(--sslu-font-family);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  transition: all var(--sslu-transition-normal) var(--sslu-transition-ease);
}

.analyzer-mode-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
  color: var(--sslu-text-secondary);
}

.analyzer-mode-btn.active {
  background: var(--sslu-gradient-brand);
  color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
  border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
}

/* Adjust debug toggle position when analyzer is visible */
.analyzer-panel:not(.hidden) ~ .debug-toggle {
  bottom: 300px;
}

/* Clip indicator — flashes amber/red when brickwall limiter engages */
.ssl-clip-indicator {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--sslu-space-5);
  left: 58px;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
  font-family: var(--sslu-font-family);
  color: #1a1a2e;
  background: #f59e0b;
  border: 1px solid #d97706;
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
  z-index: var(--sslu-z-analyzer);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: ssl-clip-flash 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

@keyframes ssl-clip-flash {
  0%   { opacity: 1; background: #ef4444; }
  50%  { opacity: 1; background: #f59e0b; }
  100% { opacity: 1; background: #f59e0b; }
}

/* Safe-volume indicator — shown on Kids/Calm screens */
.ssl-safe-volume-indicator {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--sslu-space-5);
  left: 110px;
  padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
  font-family: var(--sslu-font-family);
  color: #10b981;
  background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
  z-index: var(--sslu-z-analyzer);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  pointer-events: none;
}


/* === fm.css === */
/**
 * fm.css - FM Synthesis Controls Styles for Synth Lab
 * 6-operator FM synth panel, algorithm selector, operator strips
 */

/* ========================================
   FM Controls Container (Modal)
   ======================================== */

.fm-controls-modal {
    padding: 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

/* ========================================
   FM Section Title
   ======================================== */

.fm-title-modal {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    color: var(--sslu-synth-fm);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ========================================
   Algorithm + Feedback Row
   ======================================== */

.fm-algorithm-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.fm-algorithm-row label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #ccc;
}

.fm-algorithm-row select {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    color: #fff;

}

   ======================================== */

    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

    display: flex;

    gap: 0.15rem;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 60px;
}

/* ========================================
   LFO Rate Slider
   ======================================== */

.lfo-rate-lg {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #333, var(--sslu-synth-lfo));
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0.1rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;

    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    background: var(--sslu-synth-lfo);
    border: 2px solid #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);

.lfo-rate-lg::-moz-range-thumb {

.lfo-depth-lg::-moz-range-thumb {

.lfo-waveform-select {

/* ========================================

.lfo-target-select {

.lfo-wave-visual {

.lfo-control-label {

.lfo-tab-content {

.lfo-tab-content.hidden {

/* === mod-matrix.css === */
/**
 * mod-matrix.css - Modulation Matrix Styles for SuperSynthLab
 * Color theme: purple/violet (#a855f7 primary, #9333ea secondary)
 */

/* ========================================
   Mod Matrix Tab Content
   ======================================== */

.mod-matrix-tab-inner {
    padding: 0.3rem;
}

.mod-matrix-title {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #a855f7;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

/* ========================================
   Mod Matrix Routing Grid
   ======================================== */

.mod-matrix-grid {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.15rem;
    max-height: 180px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.mod-matrix-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    padding: 0.2rem 0.3rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #a855f7;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
}

.mod-matrix-header-enable {
    width: 18px;
    text-align: center;
}

.mod-matrix-header-slot {
    width: 24px;
    text-align: center;
}

.mod-matrix-header-source {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 80px;
}

.mod-matrix-header-dest {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 80px;
}

.mod-matrix-header-amount {
    flex: 1.5;
    min-width: 100px;
}

.mod-matrix-header-val {
    width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
}

/* ========================================
   Mod Matrix Row
   ======================================== */

.mod-matrix-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.2rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.1);
    transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
}

.mod-matrix-row.active {
    border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
    background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.05);
}

.mod-matrix-row.disabled {
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-disabled);
}

/* Enable checkbox */
.mod-matrix-enable {
    width: 18px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.mod-matrix-enable input[type="checkbox"] {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    accent-color: #a855f7;
}

/* Slot number */
.mod-matrix-slot-num {
    width: 24px;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #888;
}

/* Source/Dest dropdowns */
.mod-matrix-select {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 80px;
    padding: 0.15rem 0.2rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
    color: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.mod-matrix-select:focus {
    border-color: #a855f7;
    outline: none;
}

/* Amount slider */
.mod-matrix-amount {
    flex: 1.5;
    min-width: 100px;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    height: 8px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #9333ea, #333 50%, #a855f7);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.mod-matrix-amount::-webkit-slider-thumb {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    height: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    background: #a855f7;
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md, 6px);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

.mod-matrix-amount::-moz-range-thumb {
    width: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    height: var(--ssli-slider-thumb-size, 18px);
    background: #a855f7;
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md, 6px);
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

/* Amount value display */
.mod-matrix-amount-val {
    width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-mono);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #a855f7;
}

/* ========================================
   Activity Indicator
   ======================================== */

.mod-matrix-activity {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sslu-border-strong);
    transition: background 0.1s;
}

.mod-matrix-activity.active {
    background: #a855f7;
    box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6);
}

/* ========================================
   Mod Matrix Button (top bar)
   ======================================== */

.mod-matrix-btn {
    padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7, #7c3aed);
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.mod-matrix-btn:hover {
    filter: brightness(1.2);
}

.mod-matrix-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.98);
}

/* ========================================
   Mod Matrix Standalone Overlay
   ======================================== */

.mod-matrix-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-overlay);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    z-index: 360;
}

.mod-matrix-overlay.hidden {
    display: none;
}

.mod-matrix-panel {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-xl);
    width: 560px;
    max-width: 90vw;
    max-height: 80vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 12px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
}

.mod-matrix-panel-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
    background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.08);
}

.mod-matrix-panel-title {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #a855f7;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.mod-matrix-panel-close {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: #888;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-h3);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0 0.2rem;
    line-height: 1;
}

.mod-matrix-panel-close:hover {
    color: #fff;
}

.mod-matrix-panel-body {
    padding: 0.4rem;
}


/* === midi.css === */
/* MIDI Panel Styles */

.midi-toggle {
  background: #2a2a3a;

  color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);

  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);

  align-items: center;

}
.midi-toggle:hover {
  background: #3a3a4a;

}

.midi-status {

  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-pill);
}
.midi-connected { background: var(--sslu-success); }
.midi-disconnected { background: var(--sslu-text-dim); }

.midi-panel {
  position: fixed;
  top: 60px;
  right: var(--sslu-space-5);

  border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-strong);

}
.midi-panel.hidden { display: none; }

.midi-panel-title {
  color: var(--sslu-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-md);
  font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
  margin-bottom: var(--sslu-space-4);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-wider);
}

.midi-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sslu-space-3);
  margin-bottom: var(--sslu-space-3);
}
.midi-row label {
  color: var(--sslu-text-label);
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
  min-width: 32px;
}
.midi-row select {
  flex: 1;
  background: #2a2a3a;
  border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-hover);
  color: var(--sslu-text-secondary);
  padding: 3px 4px;
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
}

.midi-channel-map {
  color: var(--sslu-text-dim);
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-sm);
  margin: var(--sslu-space-3) 0 var(--sslu-space-4);
  padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-3);
  background: #222;
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

.midi-panic-btn {
  background: #8b0000;
  border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid #a00;
  color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-base);
  font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
  width: 100%;
  text-transform: uppercase;

}
.midi-panic-btn:hover {

}
.midi-panic-btn.panic-flash {

.midi-inst-config {

}

.midi-inst-header {

}
.midi-inst-col-lbl {
  color: var(--sslu-text-dim);

}

.midi-inst-row {

.midi-inst-label {

.midi-inst-row input[type="checkbox"] {

.midi-inst-row select {

.midiout-config-row {

.midiout-config-row label {

/* === midi-screen.css === */
/**
 * midi-screen.css - MIDI screen styles for SuperSynthLab
 * MIDI configuration, monitoring, and channel routing
 */

/* ========================================
   Screen Container
   ======================================== */

#screen-midi {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-base);
}

/* ========================================
   Top Bar
   ======================================== */

.midi-scr-top-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-3xl);
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-bar);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-raised);
    border-bottom: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.midi-scr-top-bar label {
    color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h4);
    margin-right: var(--sslu-gap-sm);
}

.midi-scr-top-bar select {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: var(--sslu-text-body);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-input);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h4);
    min-width: 120px;
}

.midi-scr-panic-btn {
    background: var(--sslu-danger-bg);
    color: var(--sslu-danger-text);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-danger-border);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h4);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
    letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-normal);
}

.midi-scr-panic-btn:hover {
    background: #882233;
}

.midi-scr-panic-btn:active {
    background: #aa3344;
}

.midi-scr-rescan-btn {
    background: #1a2a1a;
    color: #88bb88;
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid #3a5a3a;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.midi-scr-rescan-btn:hover {
    background: #2a3a2a;
}

/* ========================================
   Main Content Area
   ======================================== */

.midi-scr-main {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    gap: 0;
}

/* ========================================
   Left Panel - Channel Routing Matrix
   ======================================== */

.midi-scr-routing {
    flex: 0 0 340px;
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-section);
    border-right: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
    overflow: auto;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
}

.midi-scr-routing h3 {
    color: var(--sslu-text-label);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h2);
    margin: 0 0 0.6rem 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-wide);
}

.midi-scr-matrix-table {
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body);
    width: 100%;
}

.midi-scr-matrix-table th {
    color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-input);
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-normal);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body-sm);
    border-bottom: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
}

.midi-scr-matrix-table td {
    padding: 0.15rem 0.3rem;
    text-align: center;
    border-bottom: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-subtle);
}

.midi-scr-matrix-table .midi-scr-ch-label {
    color: var(--sslu-text-dim);
    text-align: left;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body-sm);
    padding-left: 0.4rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.midi-scr-matrix-table input[type="checkbox"] {
    min-width: var(--sslu-touch-min);
    min-height: var(--sslu-touch-min);
    cursor: pointer;
    accent-color: var(--sslu-indigo);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-4);
}

/* ========================================
   Center Panel - Live MIDI Monitor
   ======================================== */

.midi-scr-monitor {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-section);
    border-right: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
    min-width: 0;
}

.midi-scr-monitor h3 {
    color: var(--sslu-text-label);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h2);
    margin: 0 0 0.4rem 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-wide);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.midi-scr-monitor-list {
    flex: 1;
    overflow-y: auto;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-canvas);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-mono);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body);
    padding: 0.3rem;
    min-height: 0;
}

.midi-scr-msg-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-xl);
    padding: 0.15rem 0.3rem;
    border-bottom: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-subtle);
    color: var(--sslu-text-label);
}

.midi-scr-msg-row .msg-time {
    color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
    min-width: 50px;
}

.midi-scr-msg-row .msg-type {
    color: #88aaff;
    min-width: 60px;
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
}

.midi-scr-msg-row .msg-type.note-on {
    color: var(--sslu-success);
}

.midi-scr-msg-row .msg-type.note-off {
    color: var(--sslu-danger-text);
}

.midi-scr-msg-row .msg-type.cc {
    color: var(--sslu-warning);
}

.midi-scr-msg-row .msg-type.pitch-bend {
    color: var(--sslu-purple-light);
}

.midi-scr-msg-row .msg-ch {
    color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
    min-width: 30px;
}

.midi-scr-msg-row .msg-data {
    color: var(--sslu-text-body);
}

.midi-scr-msg-row .msg-hex {
    color: var(--sslu-text-dim);
    margin-left: auto;
}

/* ========================================
   Right Panel - Activity Indicators
   ======================================== */

.midi-scr-activity {
    flex: 0 0 160px;
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-section);
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.midi-scr-activity h3 {
    color: var(--sslu-text-label);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h2);
    margin: 0 0 0.6rem 0;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: var(--sslu-ls-wide);
}

.midi-scr-ch-leds {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-sm);
}

.midi-scr-ch-led-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-lg);
}

.midi-scr-ch-led-row .ch-num {
    color: var(--sslu-text-dim);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body-sm);
    min-width: 28px;
    text-align: right;
}

.midi-scr-led {
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-pill);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-highlight);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
    transition: background var(--sslu-transition-fast) var(--sslu-transition-ease), box-shadow var(--sslu-transition-fast) var(--sslu-transition-ease);
}

.midi-scr-led.active {
    background: #44ff66;
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px #44ff66;
}

/* ========================================
   Bottom Bar
   ======================================== */

.midi-scr-bottom-bar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-3xl);
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-bar);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-raised);
    border-top: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-default);
    flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.midi-scr-bottom-bar button {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: var(--sslu-text-label);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.midi-scr-bottom-bar button:hover {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
}

.midi-scr-transpose-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-md);
    margin-left: auto;
}

.midi-scr-transpose-group label {
    color: var(--sslu-text-muted);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body);
}

.midi-scr-transpose-group input[type="range"] {
    width: 120px;
    accent-color: var(--sslu-indigo);
}

.midi-scr-transpose-group .transpose-val {
    color: var(--sslu-text-body);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body);
    min-width: 36px;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-mono);
}

/* ========================================
   Phone Landscape Overrides (844x390)
   Single-pane mode, ~350px usable height
   ======================================== */

/* --- Screen container: constrain to viewport --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-midi {
    max-height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* --- Quad wrapper: fill the flex column --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-midi > .sslu-quad-wrapper {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
}

/* --- Quad: constrain content --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] #screen-midi .sslu-quad {
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* --- Main body: flex-shrink into available space --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-main {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* --- Top bar (Q1-like): fill quad, spread vertically --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-top-bar {
    padding: 8px 10px;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-md);
    min-height: 0;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    justify-content: space-evenly;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-top-bar label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    margin-right: 0;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-top-bar select {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    padding: 4px 8px;
    min-width: 100%;
    min-height: 32px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-panic-btn {
    padding: 6px 12px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    min-height: 34px;
    width: 100%;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-rescan-btn {
    padding: 5px 10px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    min-height: 32px;
}

/* --- Routing panel (Q0): scrollable, compact to fit viewport --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-routing {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: var(--sslu-space-1) var(--sslu-space-4);
    overflow-y: auto;
    max-height: 100%;
    position: relative;
}

/* Scroll indicator: fade at bottom of routing panel */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-routing::after {
    content: '\u25BC  Scroll for Ch 9\201316';
    display: block;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    color: rgba(200, 200, 220, 0.5);
    padding: 4px 0 2px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-routing h3 {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-sm);
    margin: 0 0 var(--sslu-space-2) 0;
}

/* --- Routing matrix table: compact --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-matrix-table {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-matrix-table th {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    padding: 2px 3px;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-matrix-table td {
    padding: 0px 2px;
    line-height: 1;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-matrix-table .midi-scr-ch-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    padding-left: 2px;
}

/* --- Checkboxes: custom styled toggles for phone-land --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-matrix-table input[type="checkbox"] {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    min-width: 28px;
    min-height: 28px;
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    padding: 0;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    border: var(--sslu-border-w-thin) solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-matrix-table input[type="checkbox"]:checked {
    background: var(--sslu-indigo);
    border-color: var(--sslu-indigo);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-matrix-table input[type="checkbox"]:checked::after {
    content: '\2713';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    line-height: 1;
}

/* --- Monitor panel (Q1): compact rows --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-monitor {
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-4);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-monitor h3 {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-sm);
    margin: 0 0 var(--sslu-space-2) 0;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-monitor-list {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    padding: 2px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-msg-row {
    padding: 1px 2px;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-md);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-msg-row .msg-time {
    min-width: 38px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-msg-row .msg-type {
    min-width: 48px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-msg-row .msg-ch {
    min-width: 22px;
}

/* --- Activity panel (Q2): compact LEDs --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-activity {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) var(--sslu-space-4);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-activity h3 {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-px-sm);
    margin: 0 0 var(--sslu-space-2) 0;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-ch-leds {
    gap: var(--sslu-space-1);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-ch-led-row {
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-sm);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-ch-led-row .ch-num {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    min-width: 20px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-led {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
}

/* --- Bottom bar: fill quad, spread vertically, fix transpose cutoff --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-bottom-bar {
    padding: 8px 10px;
    gap: var(--sslu-gap-md);
    min-height: 0;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    justify-content: space-evenly;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-bottom-bar button {
    padding: 5px 10px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    min-height: 32px;
    width: 100%;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-transpose-group {
    width: 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-transpose-group label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-transpose-group input[type="range"] {
    width: 100%;
    height: 8px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .midi-scr-transpose-group .transpose-val {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    min-width: 36px;
    text-align: center;
}


/* === wavefolder.css === */
/**
 * wavefolder.css - Wavefolder Synthesis Controls Styles
 * West Coast synthesis: source selector, fold amount, symmetry, bias, pre-gain
 * Accent color: magenta var(--sslu-synth-wavefold) (Buchla/West Coast vibe)
 */

/* ========================================
   Wavefolder Controls Container (Modal)
   ======================================== */

.wavefold-controls-modal {
    padding: 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.wavefold-title-modal {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-synth-wavefold);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* ========================================
   Source Waveform Selector
   ======================================== */

.wavefold-source-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.wavefold-source-row label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    min-width: 80px;
}

.wavefold-source-row select {
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #e0e0e0;
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* ========================================
   Parameter Sliders
   ======================================== */

.wavefold-param-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.wavefold-param-row label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    min-width: 80px;
}

.wavefold-param-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 80px;
    max-width: 200px;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.wavefold-param-row .wavefold-param-val {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: var(--sslu-synth-wavefold);
    min-width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
}

/* ========================================
   Source Waveform Buttons (alternative)
   ======================================== */

.wavefold-source-btn {
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    min-width: 28px;
    text-align: center;
}

.wavefold-source-btn:hover {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
    color: #e0e0e0;
}

.wavefold-source-btn.active {
    background: #5a1a3e;
    color: var(--sslu-synth-wavefold);
    border-color: var(--sslu-synth-wavefold);
}

/* ========================================
   Instrument Type Button Accent
   ======================================== */

.instrument-type-btn[data-type="wavefolder"].active {
    background: #5a1a3e;
    color: var(--sslu-synth-wavefold);
    border-color: var(--sslu-synth-wavefold);
}


/* === formant.css === */
/**
 * formant.css - Formant Oscillator Synthesis Controls Styles
 * Vowel selection, morphing controls, breathiness, formant shift
 * Accent color: warm coral (var(--sslu-synth-formant))
 */

/* ========================================
   Formant Controls Container (Modal)
   ======================================== */

.formant-controls-modal {
    padding: 0.5rem;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.formant-title-modal {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* ========================================
   Vowel Selection Row
   ======================================== */

.formant-vowel-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.formant-vowel-row .vowel-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #888;
    margin-right: 0.3rem;
}

.formant-vowel-btn {
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    min-width: 28px;
    text-align: center;
}

.formant-vowel-btn:hover {
    background: #2a2a4e;
    color: #e0e0e0;
    border-color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
}

.formant-vowel-btn:active {
    background: #3a3a5e;
}

.formant-vowel-btn.active {
    background: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
    color: #fff;
    border-color: #FF9966;
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255, 119, 68, 0.4);
}

/* ========================================
   Morph Target Row
   ======================================== */

.formant-morph-target-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.formant-morph-target-row .target-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #888;
    margin-right: 0.3rem;
}

.formant-morph-target-btn {
    padding: 2px 8px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}

.formant-morph-target-btn:hover {
    background: #2a2a4e;
    color: #e0e0e0;
}

.formant-morph-target-btn.active {
    background: rgba(255, 119, 68, 0.3);
    color: #FF9966;
    border-color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
}

/* ========================================
   Slider Controls (Morph, Breathiness, etc.)
   ======================================== */

.formant-slider-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.formant-slider-row label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    min-width: 80px;
    text-align: right;
}

.formant-slider-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 200px;
    height: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    accent-color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
}

.formant-slider-row .slider-value {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
    min-width: 36px;
    text-align: left;
}

/* ========================================
   Formant Shift Control
   ======================================== */

.formant-shift-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.formant-shift-row label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    min-width: 80px;
    text-align: right;
}

.formant-shift-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 200px;
    height: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    accent-color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
}

.formant-shift-row .shift-value {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
    min-width: 36px;
    text-align: left;
}

/* ========================================
   Vowel Sequence Controls
   ======================================== */

.formant-sequence-section {
    padding: 0.4rem;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.formant-sequence-header {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}

.formant-sequence-header label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.formant-sequence-header .seq-title {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
}

.formant-sequence-vowels {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.2rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.formant-seq-vowel-btn {
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}

.formant-seq-vowel-btn.in-sequence {
    background: rgba(255, 119, 68, 0.25);
    color: #FF9966;
    border-color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
}

.formant-seq-vowel-btn:hover {
    background: #2a2a4e;
    color: #e0e0e0;
}

.formant-sequence-rate {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
}

.formant-sequence-rate label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #b0b0b0;
}

.formant-sequence-rate input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 150px;
    height: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    accent-color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
}

.formant-sequence-rate .rate-value {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
    min-width: 30px;
}

/* ========================================
   Glottal Pulse Width Control
   ======================================== */

.formant-pulse-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.formant-pulse-row label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    min-width: 80px;
    text-align: right;
}

.formant-pulse-row input[type="range"] {
    flex: 1;
    max-width: 200px;
    height: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    accent-color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
}

.formant-pulse-row .pulse-value {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
    min-width: 36px;
    text-align: left;
}

/* ========================================
   Formant Visualizer (optional display)
   ======================================== */

.formant-viz-container {
    height: 60px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-medium);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.formant-viz-bar {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 8px;
    background: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
    border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
    transition: height 0.2s ease, left 0.2s ease;
}

.formant-viz-label {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -14px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #888;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
}

/* ========================================
   Section Dividers
   ======================================== */

.formant-divider {
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, var(--sslu-synth-formant)40, transparent);
    margin: 0.4rem 0;
}

/* ========================================
   Accent Overrides for Formant Engine
   ======================================== */

.formant-controls-modal input[type="checkbox"] {
    accent-color: var(--sslu-synth-formant);
}

.formant-controls-modal select {
    padding: 2px 4px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);

    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #CC9944;
    min-width: 20px;
}

.reed-param-row select {
    padding: 2px 4px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #e0e0e0;
    border: 1px solid #CC9944;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
}

/* ========================================
   Register Toggle
   ======================================== */

.reed-register-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    align-items: center;
}

.reed-register-toggle button {
    padding: 2px 8px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    color: #b0b0b0;
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
}

.reed-register-toggle button.active {
    background: #CC9944;
    color: #1a1a2e;
    border-color: #CC9944;
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
}

.reed-register-toggle button:hover {
    border-color: #CC9944;
}

/* ========================================
   Header
   ======================================== */

.reed-header {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: #CC9944;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

/* ========================================
   Vibrato Section
   ======================================== */

.reed-vibrato-group {
    margin-top: 0.3rem;
    padding-top: 0.3rem;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(204, 153, 68, 0.15);
}

.reed-vibrato-group .reed-param-row label {
    color: #CC9944;
    opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}


/* === feedback.css === */
/**
 * feedback.css - Feedback System & About Panel Styles
 */

/* ========================================
   Context Menu
   ======================================== */

.ssl-context-menu {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 100000;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-raised);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-cyan);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-2) 0;
    min-width: 220px;
    box-shadow: var(--sslu-shadow-md);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-body-sm);
    display: none;
}

.ssl-context-menu-item {
    padding: 6px 14px;
    color: #ccc;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.ssl-context-menu-item:hover {
    background: var(--sslu-cyan);
    color: #111;
}

/* ========================================
   Feedback Modal
   ======================================== */

.ssl-feedback-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-overlay);
    z-index: 100001;
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.ssl-feedback-overlay.visible {
    display: flex;
}

.ssl-feedback-modal {
    background: var(--sslu-bg-input);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-cyan);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-2xl);
    padding: var(--sslu-space-10);
    width: 380px;
    max-width: 90vw;
    max-height: 80vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.15);
}

.ssl-feedback-title {
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-h2);
    color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    text-align: center;
}

.ssl-feedback-element-id {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #888;
    background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-input);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-mono);
    text-align: center;
}

.ssl-feedback-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    color: #aaa;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    display: block;
}

.ssl-feedback-rating {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ssl-feedback-rating-btn {
    padding: var(--sslu-pad-btn);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-tiny);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-md);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
    color: #ccc;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
}

.ssl-feedback-rating-btn:hover {
    border-color: #4cc9f0;
    color: #fff;
}

.ssl-feedback-rating-btn.selected {
    background: var(--sslu-cyan);
    color: #111;
    border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
    font-weight: var(--sslu-fw-bold);
}

.ssl-feedback-textarea {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 80px;
    padding: 8px;
    border-radius: var(--sslu-radius-lg);
    border: 1px solid var(--sslu-border-strong);
    background: var(--sslu-bg-button);
    color: var(--sslu-text-primary);
    font-size: var(--sslu-fs-small);
    font-family: var(--sslu-font-family);
    resize: vertical;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.ssl-feedback-textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--sslu-cyan);
}

.ssl-feedback-submit {
    width: 100%;
