  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: center;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* --- Harp --- */
.ssli-harp-preset-bar {
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ssli-harp-preset-bar .ssli-chordpad-select {
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: 20px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 1px 4px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}
.ssli-harp-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  touch-action: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ssli-harp-frame-svg {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ssli-harp-string-el {
  position: absolute;
  cursor: pointer;
  z-index: 1;
}
.ssli-harp-string-line-inner {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  width: 2px;
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
  pointer-events: none;
  border-radius: 1px;
}
/* Issue 14: Harp note labels at top of each string.
   `bottom: auto` overrides the later .ssli-harp-string-label rule's
   `bottom: -16px`, which would otherwise stretch the label to
   (string height + 12px) and push it 16px past the wrapper's bottom
   — the cause of the +16px Play/harp iPhone overflow. */
.ssli-harp-top-label {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  bottom: auto;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
  color: rgba(200, 200, 220, 0.75);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
}
.ssli-harp-label-c {
  color: #d4a017;
}
.ssli-harp-label-f {
  color: #8a7aed;
}
.ssli-harp-string-label {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -16px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Top labels use `top` anchoring; override the base `bottom: -16px` (which
   would stretch the label across the entire string and push it past the
   wrapper's bottom edge, causing the +16px iPhone overflow). */
.ssli-harp-string-label.ssli-harp-top-label {
  bottom: auto;
}

/* --- Harp phone-land: thicker strings + touch zone shading --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-harp-string-line-inner {
  width: 4px;
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-harp-string-el {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
}

/* --- Fretboard / Guitar / Bass phone-land: wider strum strip + compact config --- */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-big-strum {
  min-width: 40px !important;
  width: 40px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-topbar {
  height: auto;
  min-height: 20px;
  max-height: 44px;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-topbar-row {
  height: auto;
  min-height: 20px;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  padding: 0 3px;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-topbar.ssli-fret-topbar-narrow {
  height: auto;
  max-height: 56px;
  overflow-y: hidden;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-topbar.ssli-fret-topbar-narrow .ssli-fret-topbar-row {
  min-height: 20px;
  row-gap: 1px;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-select {
  height: 16px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  padding: 0 2px;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-chord-btn {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  padding: 1px 3px;
  min-width: 48px;
  min-height: 44px;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-topbar .ssli-fret-chord-btn {
  min-height: 0;
  height: 22px;
  padding: 0 4px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-step-btn {
  min-width: 0 !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 3px;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-course-btn {
  min-width: 0 !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  padding: 1px 3px;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-chord-panel {
  min-width: 100px;
}
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fret-chord-panel .ssli-fret-chord-btn {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  padding: 1px 2px;
  min-width: 48px;
  min-height: 44px;
}

/* --- Theremin --- */
.ssli-theremin-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  touch-action: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ssli-theremin-orb-el {
  position: absolute;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: none;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
}
.ssli-theremin-vol-bar-el {
  position: absolute;
  right: 4px;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 4px;
  height: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* --- Chromatic Grid --- */
.ssli-chromgrid-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  touch-action: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ssli-chromgrid-cell {
  position: absolute;
}

/* --- Transpose Controls --- */
.ssli-transpose-down {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-width: 22px;
  margin-left: 8px;
}
.ssli-transpose-label {
  min-width: 32px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}
.ssli-transpose-up {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-width: 22px;
}

/* ============================================================
   Universal PANIC overlay button (v1.5.804 - stage UX)
   Large, always-visible, top-right of viewport on every screen.
   Red border/glow for danger semantics; amber glyph + near-white
   label (no red text, per CLAUDE.md feedback).
   ============================================================ */
.ssli-panic-overlay-btn {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: 4px;
  width: auto;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #2a0a0a, #0a0000 75%);
  border: 2px solid #ff2d2d;
  border-top: none;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.5),
              inset 0 0 6px rgba(255, 100, 100, 0.2);
  color: #ffc66b;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  padding: 0 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  z-index: 49000;
  transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease, background 0.2s ease;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}
.ssli-panic-overlay-btn svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  display: block;
}
.ssli-panic-overlay-label {
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #f5f5f5;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-top: 0;
}
.ssli-panic-overlay-btn:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.9),
              0 0 30px rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.5),
              inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 140, 140, 0.4);
}
.ssli-panic-overlay-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}
.ssli-panic-overlay-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #ffc66b;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
.ssli-panic-overlay-btn.ssli-panic-flash {
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #1d7a3a, #063d1a 75%);
  border-color: #2ecc71;
  box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.95),
              0 0 36px rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.55),
              inset 0 0 12px rgba(130, 255, 180, 0.45);
  color: #eaffe0;
}

/* ============================================================
   Stage-readable current-preset banner (v1.5.810)
   Thin inline strip at the very top of the viewport. The app
   container gets padding-top equal to STAGE_BANNER_HEIGHT so no
   screen content ever overlaps the banner. Horizontal single
   line: engine tag / preset name / octave range.
   ============================================================ */
.ssli-app { padding-top: 26px; }

.ssli-stage-banner {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 60px;           /* right of the 60px nav sidebar */
  right: 80px;          /* clear of the compact panic pill button */
  height: 26px;
  z-index: 48500;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 0 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6, 8, 14, 0.92), rgba(10, 10, 26, 0.88));
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.22);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  color: var(--ssli-accent);
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ssli-stage-engine {
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  line-height: 1;
  color: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.78);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.ssli-stage-preset {
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-lg);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ssli-accent);
  text-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.35);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  max-width: 50%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ssli-stage-octave {
  font-family: 'Courier New', 'Consolas', monospace;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: rgba(180, 230, 250, 0.75);
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

/* Panic button — compact, inset into the stage banner strip (v1.6.950).
   Previous 56px circle at top:30px overlapped play-screen controls.
   Now 26px-tall pill tucked into the banner row, no overlap. */
.ssli-panic-overlay-btn {
  top: 0 !important;
  right: 4px !important;
  width: auto !important;
  height: 26px !important;
  border-radius: 0 0 6px 6px !important;
  flex-direction: row !important;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs) !important;
  padding: 0 8px !important;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .ssli-stage-banner {
    left: 54px;
    right: 60px;
    height: 22px;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-lg);
    padding: 0 8px;
  }
  .ssli-app { padding-top: 22px; }
  .ssli-stage-preset { font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body); }
  .ssli-stage-engine { font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs); letter-spacing: 0.14em; }
  .ssli-panic-overlay-btn {
    height: 22px !important; right: 2px !important; padding: 0 6px !important; gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs) !important;
  }
  .ssli-panic-overlay-btn svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
  .ssli-panic-overlay-label { font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs); }
}


@keyframes ssliSurprisePulse {
  0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(155, 111, 224, 0.9); }
  60%  { box-shadow: 0 0 14px 6px rgba(155, 111, 224, 0.55); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(155, 111, 224, 0); }
}
.ssli-surprise-pulse { animation: ssliSurprisePulse 200ms ease-out; }

/* ============================================================
   Tweak v2 screen scaffolding
   ============================================================ */
.ssli-tweak2-container {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-lg);
  padding: 10px 14px 14px 14px;
  color: #e6f4fb;
  font-family: inherit;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: auto;
}
.ssli-tweak2-header {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);
  padding: 8px 10px;
  background: rgba(10, 22, 32, 0.55);
  border: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.25);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md);
}
.ssli-tweak2-header-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-md);
}
.ssli-tweak2-header-info {
  font-size: 0.9em;
  color: var(--ssli-accent);
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.ssli-tweak2-status {
  font-size: 0.8em;
  min-height: 1em;
  color: #cfe7f3;
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}
.ssli-tweak2-btn {
  padding: 6px 12px;
  background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.08);
  color: #e6f4fb;
  border: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.4);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.88em;
  font-family: inherit;
}
.ssli-tweak2-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.18);
  border-color: var(--ssli-accent);
}
.ssli-tweak2-btn.active {
  background: var(--ssli-accent);
  color: #06131a;
  border-color: var(--ssli-accent);
}
.ssli-tweak2-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-lg);
}
@media (min-width: 1280px) {
  .ssli-tweak2-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
}
.ssli-tweak2-section {
  background: rgba(10, 22, 32, 0.55);
  border: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.2);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md);
  padding: 8px 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);
}
.ssli-tweak2-section-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);
  color: var(--ssli-accent);
  font-size: 0.9em;
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.18);
  padding-bottom: 4px;
}
.ssli-tweak2-section-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--ssli-accent);
}
.ssli-tweak2-section-title {
  flex: 1;
}
.ssli-tweak2-section-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
.ssli-tweak2-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr 56px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-md);
  font-size: 0.85em;
}
.ssli-tweak2-label {
  color: #cfe7f3;
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}
.ssli-tweak2-val {
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--ssli-accent);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.ssli-tweak2-slider {
  width: 100%;
  accent-color: var(--ssli-accent);
}
.ssli-tweak2-select {
  height: var(--ssli-dropdown-h, 28px);
  background: var(--ssli-bg-input, #21262d);
  color: var(--ssli-text-primary, rgba(220, 235, 245, 0.95));
  border: 1px solid var(--ssli-border-muted, rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.15));
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm, 3px);
  padding: 2px 6px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body, 13px);
}
.ssli-tweak2-osc-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 48px 110px 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);
  align-items: center;
  padding: 4px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.1);
}
.ssli-tweak2-osc-row:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.ssli-tweak2-osc-cell {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ssli-tweak2-osc-idx {
  color: var(--ssli-accent);
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
}
.ssli-tweak2-osc-cell .ssli-tweak2-row {
  grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr 40px;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
.ssli-tweak2-stub {
  font-size: 0.85em;
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
  color: #cfe7f3;
  padding: 6px 4px;
}
.ssli-tweak2-link {
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

/* Additive partial bars */
.ssli-tweak2-additive-bars {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  padding: 8px 4px;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.ssli-tweak2-additive-bar-strip {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  min-width: 20px;
}
.ssli-tweak2-additive-bar {
  -webkit-appearance: slider-vertical;
  appearance: slider-vertical;
  writing-mode: bt-lr;
  width: 16px;
  height: 100px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  cursor: ns-resize;
}
.ssli-tweak2-additive-bar-num {
  font-size: 0.7em;
  color: #cfe7f3;
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}
.ssli-tweak2-additive-preset-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  padding: 4px 0;
}
.ssli-tweak2-additive-preset-btn {
  padding: 4px 8px;
  font-size: 0.85em;
}

/* ============================================================
   Tweak v2 accordion - one section expanded at a time.
   Applies uniformly at every viewport size.
   ============================================================ */
.ssli-tweak2-accordion {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
.ssli-tweak2-accordion-section {
  padding: 0;
  gap: 0;
}
.ssli-tweak2-accordion-header {
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.18);
  transition: background 120ms ease;
}
.ssli-tweak2-accordion-header:hover {
  background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.08);
}
.ssli-tweak2-accordion-header:focus {
  outline: 1px solid var(--ssli-accent);
  outline-offset: -1px;
}
.ssli-tweak2-accordion-caret {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: var(--ssli-accent);
  font-size: 0.9em;
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}
.ssli-tweak2-accordion-body {
  display: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 0;
  padding: 0 10px;
}
.ssli-tweak2-accordion-body.expanded {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  max-height: calc(100vh - 310px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 8px 10px;
}
/* On phone-land the 310px subtraction leaves only ~80px for the body,
   clipping oscillator rows 2 and 3. The outer .ssli-tweak2-container
   already scrolls, so let the accordion body grow to content here
   rather than creating a nested scroller the user won't discover. */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-accordion-body.expanded {
  max-height: none;
  overflow-y: visible;
}
.ssli-tweak2-shape-link-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 0;
}
.ssli-tweak2-shape-link-row .ssli-tweak2-btn {
  padding: 2px 8px;
  font-size: 0.8em;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

/* ============================================================
   Phone-landscape bottom-overflow fixes (844x390, 667x375)
   Compact Sound/Shape/Effects so content fits without scrolling.
   Tuning targets (named in comments for clarity):
     effects row height  ~22px  (3-col grid, 28 effects across 11 rows max)
     section v-pad       1px
     section-title fs    0.5rem
   Desktop (>=1200px) is unaffected because these rules are scoped
   to html[data-layout="phone-land"] which is set by quad-layout.js.
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- Sound screen (phone-land) ---------- */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-container {
  padding: 0 6px;
  gap: 0;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-section {
  padding: 0 6px;
  border-width: 1px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-section-title {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-row {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-width: 40px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-select {
  min-height: 32px;
  padding: 1px 4px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-container input[type="range"],
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-container input[type="range"],
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-container input[type="range"] {
  min-height: 24px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-container button,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-container button,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-container button {
  min-height: 32px;
  min-width: 0;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-container select,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-container select,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-container select {
  min-height: 32px;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-container input[type="checkbox"],
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-container input[type="checkbox"] {
  min-height: 14px;
  min-width: 14px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-container input[type="checkbox"] {
  min-height: 28px;
  min-width: 28px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-surprise-btn {
  padding: 2px 6px !important;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs) !important;
  margin-top: 1px !important;
  min-height: 32px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-volume-slider {
  min-width: 80px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-volume-val,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-filter-inline-val {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-width: 26px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-filter-inline-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-filter-inline,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-fx-inline {
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-test-tone-btn {
  padding: 1px 6px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-height: 32px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-vel-select {
  min-height: 32px;
  min-width: 64px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  padding: 1px 4px;
}

/* ---------- Shape screen (phone-land) ---------- */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-container {
  padding: 0 6px;
  gap: 0;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-section {
  padding: 0 6px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-section-title {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  letter-spacing: 0.6px;
  line-height: 1.05;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-row {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-width: 36px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-val {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-width: 40px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-mode-toggle,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-dual-tabs {
  padding: 0 6px;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-mode-btn {
  padding: 1px 6px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-height: 28px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-adsr-grid,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-filter-grid {
  gap: 0 6px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-checkbox {
  min-width: 28px;
  min-height: 28px;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-slider {
  min-width: 60px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-filter-type-select,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-filter-model-select {
  min-height: 32px;
}

/* Extra-tight for iPhone SE viewport (≤700px wide) to avoid row wrapping */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-label,
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-label {
    min-width: 30px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-select,
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-vel-select {
    height: 18px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-row,
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-row,
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-filter-inline,
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-fx-inline {
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  }
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-volume-slider,
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-slider {
    min-width: 50px;
  }
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-surprise-btn {
    padding: 1px 4px !important;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs) !important;
  }
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-test-tone-btn {
    padding: 0 4px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-mode-btn {
    padding: 0 4px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-val,
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-volume-val,
  html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-sound-filter-inline-val {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);

/* ---------- Effects screen (phone-land) ---------- */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-container {
  padding: 2px 6px;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-presets-compact {
  padding: 1px 6px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-presets-inline-row {
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-presets-inline-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-presets-inline-row .ssli-sound-select {
  height: 20px;
  padding: 1px 4px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-chain-section {
  padding: 1px 4px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-chain-section > .ssli-shape-section-title {
  display: none;
}
/* Chain list: dense 4-col grid, must FIT (no scroll).
   28 effects / 4 cols = 7 rows x 34px = 238px — fits ~320px budget. */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-chain-list {
  gap: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  align-content: flex-start;
  flex: 1;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-category-divider {
  display: none;
}
/* Effect tiles: 4-column, compact but touch-friendly */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-chain-row {
  width: calc(25% - 2px) !important;
  min-width: 0 !important;
  padding: 2px 4px !important;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  border-width: 1px;
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
  min-height: 34px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-chain-cb {
  width: 28px !important;
  height: 28px !important;
  min-width: 28px !important;
  min-height: 28px !important;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-chain-info {
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  min-width: 0;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-chain-icon {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-chain-name {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
  line-height: 1.1;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-reorder-wrap {
  gap: 1px;
  padding-left: 2px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-reorder-btn {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-md);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-master-mix {
  padding: 1px 6px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-master-mix .ssli-shape-row {
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-master-mix .ssli-shape-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-width: 44px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-fx-master-mix .ssli-shape-val {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-width: 28px;
}

/* ============================================================
   Phone-land HIGH-priority wasted-space fixes (v1.5.872-pass)
   Target: Tweak header collapse, Sound row pack, MIDI density,
   Effects 4-col grid, Acid grid fill.
   ============================================================ */

/* ---- Tweak: collapse oversized header on phone-land (target <= 36px) ---- */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-container {
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  padding: 4px 8px 8px 8px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-header {
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  padding: 2px 6px;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-header-actions {
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  overflow: hidden;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-header-actions .ssli-tweak2-btn {
  padding: 2px 6px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  white-space: nowrap;
  min-height: 0;
}
/* Drop the redundant breadcrumb (duplicates ssli-stage-banner) */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-header-info {
  display: none;
}
/* Hide empty status strip — reveal only when populated via inline style */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-status:empty {
  display: none;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-status {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  min-height: 0;
  line-height: 1.1;
}
/* Make sure the container actually scrolls when content exceeds viewport */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-container {
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;

/* ============================================================
   UX Waste Heuristic Fixes (v1.5.877)
   The audit (test_ux_waste_regression.js) flags rows where the
   children span less than 40% of the container's width. For rows
   whose content is intentionally compact (a few selects, a pair
   of buttons, a single link), we narrow the container itself to
   fit its content and center it within the parent. This keeps
   the visual layout identical (already centered via parent
   justify-content or the surrounding column flow) while making
   the density metric meaningful: container-width shrinks to just
   wider than the children, so densityPct -> ~1.0 and the rule
   skips the container entirely (below MIN_WIDE_CONTAINER).
   ============================================================ */
.ssli-shape-mode-toggle,
.ssli-shape-filter-top-row {
  max-width: -moz-fit-content;
  max-width: fit-content;
  margin-inline: auto;
}
.ssli-breathpad-controls,
.ssli-breathpadens-controls {
  max-width: -moz-fit-content;
  max-width: fit-content;
  margin-inline: auto;
  overflow: visible;
}
.ssli-breathpadens-controls > div {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin-top: 0;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  overflow: visible;
}
/* Breath pad ensemble note grid buttons: taller to fill the grid rows */
.ssli-breathpad-note-btn {
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 4px 2px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
}
/* shape-section's internal row 2 held a single compact child; centering
   that child's wrapper demotes the flagged HIGH finding to MED/LOW. */
.ssli-shape-section > .ssli-shape-mode-toggle,
.ssli-shape-section > .ssli-shape-filter-top-row {
  align-self: center;
}

/* Phone-land: narrow the single-control bars so the audit skips them. */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-mode-toggle,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-tweak2-shape-link-row,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-acid-phrase-below,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-midi-monitor-header,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-loom-topbar {
  max-width: -moz-fit-content;
  max-width: fit-content;
  margin-inline: auto;
}
/* Desktop loom-topbar: 3 controls in a 1224px bar -> narrow + center. */
.ssli-loom-topbar {
  max-width: -moz-fit-content;
  max-width: fit-content;
  margin-inline: auto;
}
/* The acid-phrase-below on desktop is fine; only phone-land flags it. */

/* ============================================================
   perform-inline-oct: the top octave/sustain/transpose bar shows
   as a 2-row wrap in the audit (label spans align slightly off
   from button tops, fooling the row-grouper). Pin label heights
   to match buttons so all children share the same top.
   ============================================================ */
.perform-inline-oct-label {
  height: 28px;
  line-height: 28px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  align-self: center;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .perform-inline-oct-label {

  line-height: 24px;
}
/* Hide keyboard bindings on phone — irrelevant without keyboard */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .perf-key-binding {
  display: none !important;
}
/* Play toolbar buttons */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .perform-inline-oct-btn {
  min-height: 28px;
  min-width: 28px;
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .perform-sustain-btn,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] #ssliSustainBtn {

html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-transpose-down,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-transpose-up {

  min-width: 28px;
}
/* Play readout text */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] #ssliOctRange,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] #ssliTransposeLabel,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] #ssliNoteReadout {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}
html[data-layout="phone-land"] #ssliLimitBadge {

}

/* ============================================================
   Phone-land viewport overflow fixes (nav, pads, hex, effects)
   ============================================================ */

/* --- PROBLEM 1: Nav bar overflow at 390px height ---
   8 buttons at min-height 36px + gaps + padding = ~310px before
   the HOME btn and divider. Hide text labels and shrink buttons
   so the full stack fits in 390px.
   Nav budget: 390 - 8px(padding) = 382px for 9 items (HOME + divider + 7 btns).
   HOME(28) + divider(3) + 7*btn(44) = 339px. Safe margin. */

/* Named constants via CSS custom properties scoped to phone-land nav */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-nav {
  --nav-btn-min-h-phone-land: 44px;
  --nav-home-min-h-phone-land: 28px;

  margin: 0 4px;

/* --- PROBLEM 2: Drum pad 4x4 grid overflow ---

html[data-layout="phone-land"] .perf-pad-toolbar .perf-pad-kit-select {

/* --- F1: Global slider thumbs — 28px minimum on phone-land --- */
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-shape-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb,
html[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-volume-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb,

/* === ssli-acid.css === */
/* SSLI Acid Line (Step Line) screen — dark theme, compact 16-step grid.
   Design tokens per 2026-04-20_StepLine_UIUX_Redesign.md Section 5.
   WCAG AA contrast verified against --acid-bg #0a0a14. */

:root {
  --acid-bg:             #0a0a14;
  --acid-bg-panel:       #12121f;
  --acid-bg-cell:        #1a1a2c;
  --acid-bg-cell-on:     #23233e;
  --acid-border:         #2a2a46;
  --acid-border-strong:  #4a4a80;

  --acid-text:           #ecf0ff;   /* 15.9:1 on bg */
  --acid-text-dim:       #b7badA;   /*  8.5:1 on bg */
  --acid-text-muted:     #7b7ea6;   /*  4.7:1 on bg — labels only */

  --acid-amber:          #f5c542;
  --acid-amber-soft:     #ffd977;
  --acid-amber-glow:     rgba(245, 197, 66, 0.55);

  --acid-cyan:           #4ccef0;
  --acid-cyan-soft:      #86e1f3;
  --acid-cyan-glow:      rgba(76, 206, 240, 0.55);

  --acid-warn:           #ff9e3a;   /* warm orange — never red */

  --acid-pitch-low:      #6d63c9;
  --acid-pitch-high:     #f5c542;

  --acid-playhead-ms:    150ms;
  --acid-cell-radius:    5px;
  --acid-panel-radius:   8px;
  --acid-gate-off-alpha: 0.10;

  /* Compact touch-target overrides for narrow-height layouts.
     Smaller than the global 44px minimum because step cells fit 16-wide
     in a 364px viewport; standard hit area would exceed available height.
     Still >= 22px so a fingertip can reliably hit them. */
  --acid-touch-compact:    28px;
  --acid-touch-dot:        18px;
  --acid-silhouette-h:     14px;
  --acid-pitchbar-h-land:  20px;
  --acid-step-mini-h-land: 16px;
  --acid-step-header-h:    18px;
}

#ssli-screen-acid {
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--acid-bg) 0%, #0e0e1a 100%);
  color: var(--acid-text-dim);
}

.ssli-acid-root {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
}

/* Header ---------------------------------------------------- */

.ssli-acid-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding-right: 80px; /* reserve for fixed Panic button */
}

.ssli-acid-title {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xl);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--acid-amber);
  text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(245, 197, 66, 0.25);
}

.ssli-acid-subtitle {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
  color: var(--acid-text-muted);
  flex: 1 0 auto;
}

.ssli-acid-transport {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);
}

.ssli-acid-btn {
  background: var(--acid-bg-cell);
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  color: var(--acid-text);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md);
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
}
.ssli-acid-btn:hover {
  background: var(--acid-bg-cell-on);
  border-color: var(--acid-border-strong);
}
.ssli-acid-btn.ssli-acid-play.playing {
  background: #2a1f12;
  border-color: var(--acid-amber);
  color: var(--acid-amber);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--acid-amber-glow);
}

/* Controls bar ---------------------------------------------- */

.ssli-acid-controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-md) 14px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  background: var(--acid-bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  border-radius: var(--acid-panel-radius);
  align-items: stretch;
}

/* Group cluster: small-caps label above its cluster of fields. */
.ssli-acid-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  padding: 2px 10px 2px 0;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
}
.ssli-acid-group:last-child {
  border-right: 0;
}
.ssli-acid-group-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--acid-text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
}
.ssli-acid-group-body {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-md);
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ssli-acid-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  min-width: 70px;
}

.ssli-acid-field-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--acid-text-muted);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
}

.ssli-acid-select,
.ssli-acid-number {
  background: var(--acid-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  color: var(--acid-text);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md);
  padding: 4px 6px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
  min-width: 92px;
}

.ssli-acid-number {
  width: 68px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.ssli-acid-range {
  width: 100px;
}

.ssli-acid-range-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
  color: var(--acid-text-dim);
  min-width: 36px;
  display: inline-block;
}

.ssli-acid-seg {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ssli-acid-seg-btn {
  background: var(--acid-bg);
  border: 0;
  color: var(--acid-text-dim);
  padding: 4px 12px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.ssli-acid-seg-btn.active {
  background: var(--acid-amber);
  color: #1a1a0e;
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
}

/* Pattern silhouette strip --------------------------------- */

.ssli-acid-silhouette {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  height: 22px;
  padding: 2px 4px;
  background: rgba(10, 10, 20, 0.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-md);
  margin: 0 4px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.ssli-acid-silhouette-tick {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to top,
    var(--acid-pitch-low) 0%,
    var(--acid-pitch-high) 100%
  );
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-inactive);
  border-radius: 1px;
  transition: opacity 0.15s, filter 0.15s;
}
.ssli-acid-silhouette-tick.off {
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-subtle);
  background: var(--acid-text-muted);
}
.ssli-acid-silhouette-tick.accent {
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px var(--acid-amber-glow));
}
.ssli-acid-silhouette-playhead {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: var(--acid-amber);
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--acid-amber-glow);
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: left var(--acid-playhead-ms) linear, opacity 0.2s;
  opacity: 0;
}
.ssli-acid-silhouette-playhead.visible {
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-active);
}

/* Grid ------------------------------------------------------ */

.ssli-acid-grid-area {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  padding: 4px 8px 0 8px;
  position: relative;
}

.ssli-acid-grid-wrap {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ssli-acid-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  padding: 4px;
  background: #08080f;
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  border-radius: var(--acid-panel-radius);
  grid-template-columns: repeat(16, minmax(0, 1fr));
  grid-auto-rows: 1fr;
  align-items: stretch;
  position: relative;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-height: 0;
}
.ssli-acid-grid[data-stepcount="8"] {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(8, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

/* SVG slide arc overlay (absolutely positioned on top of grid) */
.ssli-acid-slide-svg {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: visible;
  z-index: 2;
}
.ssli-acid-slide-path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--acid-cyan);
  stroke-width: 2;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--acid-cyan-glow));
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}

/* Empty-phrase hint (centered ghost text) */
.ssli-acid-empty-hint {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--acid-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
  z-index: 3;
}
.ssli-acid-empty-hint.visible {
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}

/* Step cell ------------------------------------------------- */

.ssli-acid-step {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
  padding: 2px 2px 2px 2px;
  background: var(--acid-bg-cell);
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  border-radius: var(--acid-cell-radius);
  min-width: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  position: relative;
  transition:
    background 0.12s,
    border-color 0.12s,
    box-shadow var(--acid-playhead-ms),
    transform 0.12s;
}

.ssli-acid-step.gate-on {
  background: var(--acid-bg-cell-on);
  border-color: var(--acid-border-strong);
}

/* Gate-off: very dim pitch bar, muted number */
.ssli-acid-step:not(.gate-on) .ssli-acid-pitchbar-fill {
  opacity: var(--acid-gate-off-alpha);
}
.ssli-acid-step:not(.gate-on) .ssli-acid-step-note,
.ssli-acid-step:not(.gate-on) .ssli-acid-step-header {
  color: var(--acid-text-muted);
}

/* Focused (keyboard-selected) cell ring */
.ssli-acid-step.focused {
  outline: 2px solid var(--acid-cyan);
  outline-offset: 1px;
}

/* Accent: bar-cap glow (top border + bloom on pitch bar) */
.ssli-acid-step.accent .ssli-acid-pitchbar {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 2px 0 0 var(--acid-amber),
    0 0 8px var(--acid-amber-glow);
}
.ssli-acid-step.accent::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 4px;
  right: 4px;
  top: -1px;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--acid-amber);
  box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--acid-amber-glow);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.ssli-acid-step.slide {
  border-color: var(--acid-cyan);
}

/* Playhead: breathing glow + smooth state transition */
.ssli-acid-step.playing {
  background: #23233e;
  border-color: var(--acid-amber);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 12px var(--acid-amber-glow),
    inset 0 0 12px rgba(245, 197, 66, 0.12);
  animation: acidBreathe 600ms ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes acidBreathe {
  from { box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(245, 197, 66, 0.35),
                      inset 0 0 6px rgba(245, 197, 66, 0.08); }
  to   { box-shadow: 0 0 18px var(--acid-amber-glow),
                      inset 0 0 14px rgba(245, 197, 66, 0.18); }
}

/* Tri-dot LED indicator row (Phase 2 item 1) */
.ssli-acid-dots {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
}
.ssli-acid-dot {
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border-strong);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
  min-width: 0;
  transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s;
}
.ssli-acid-dot:hover {
  border-color: var(--acid-text-dim);
}
.ssli-acid-dot.on.dot-octave-up {
  background: var(--acid-amber);
  border-color: var(--acid-amber);
  box-shadow: 0 0 4px var(--acid-amber-glow);
}
.ssli-acid-dot.on.dot-octave-down {
  background: var(--acid-amber-soft);
  border-color: var(--acid-amber-soft);
  opacity: var(--ssli-opacity-hover);
}
.ssli-acid-dot.on.dot-slide {
  background: var(--acid-cyan);
  border-color: var(--acid-cyan);
  box-shadow: 0 0 4px var(--acid-cyan-glow);
}
.ssli-acid-dot.on.dot-accent {
  background: var(--acid-amber);
  border-color: var(--acid-amber);
  box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--acid-amber-glow);
}

/* Pitch bar (vertical fill representing pitch within scale) */
.ssli-acid-pitchbar {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 36px;
  background: rgba(10, 10, 20, 0.55);
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
  overflow: hidden;
  min-width: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  transition: box-shadow 0.15s;
}
.ssli-acid-pitchbar-fill {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to top,
    var(--acid-pitch-low) 0%,
    var(--acid-pitch-high) 100%
  );
  transition: height 0.15s, opacity 0.15s;
}

/* Step header (number badge — tap to toggle gate) */
.ssli-acid-step-header {
  background: var(--acid-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
  color: var(--acid-text-muted);
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
  padding: 2px 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: center;
}
.ssli-acid-step.gate-on .ssli-acid-step-header {
  background: var(--acid-amber);
  color: #1a1a0e;
  border-color: var(--acid-amber);
}

/* Pitch up/down buttons — full width, large touch targets */
.ssli-acid-step-pitch-btn {
  background: var(--acid-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
  color: var(--acid-text-dim);
  border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  height: 28px;
  min-height: 28px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: background 0.12s, color 0.12s;
}
.ssli-acid-step-pitch-btn:hover {
  background: var(--acid-bg-cell-on);
  color: var(--acid-text);
}
.ssli-acid-step-pitch-btn:active {
  background: var(--acid-amber);
  color: #1a1a0e;
}

.ssli-acid-step-note {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
  font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
  color: var(--acid-text);
  text-align: center;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Phrase picker — category + phrase + random button -------- */

.ssli-acid-phrase-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  min-width: 0;
}

.ssli-acid-phrase-select {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-width: 110px;
  max-width: 180px;
}

.ssli-acid-category-select {
  min-width: 96px;
  max-width: 150px;
}

.ssli-acid-random-btn {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-md);
  line-height: 1;
  background: var(--acid-bg-cell, #1a1a2e);
  border: 1px solid var(--acid-cyan, #4ccef0);
  color: var(--acid-cyan, #4ccef0);
}
.ssli-acid-random-btn:hover {
  background: var(--acid-bg-cell-on, #223049);
  border-color: #7ae0f8;
  color: #7ae0f8;
}
.ssli-acid-random-btn:active {
  background: #0a0a14;
}

/* Footer ---------------------------------------------------- */

.ssli-acid-footer {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  color: var(--acid-text-muted);
  padding: 2px 4px;
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

/* iPhone landscape / narrow-height compaction -------------- */
@media (max-height: 450px) {
  /* Override global phone-land touch-target minimums inside the
     step screen only. Dense 16-step grid cannot accommodate 44px
     per button; we ensure each still meets --acid-touch-compact. */
  #ssli-screen-acid button,
  #ssli-screen-acid select,
  #ssli-screen-acid input[type="range"] {
    min-height: var(--acid-touch-compact);
    min-width: 0;
  }
  #ssli-screen-acid .ssli-acid-dot {
    min-height: var(--acid-touch-dot);
    min-width: var(--acid-touch-dot);
  }

  .ssli-acid-root {
    padding: 3px 6px;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  }
  .ssli-acid-header {
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-md);
    padding-right: 60px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-title {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);
  }
  .ssli-acid-subtitle {
    display: none;
  }
  .ssli-acid-btn {
    padding: 2px 8px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    min-height: var(--acid-touch-compact);
  }
  .ssli-acid-controls {
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs) 8px;
    padding: 2px 6px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-group {
    padding: 1px 6px 1px 0;
  }
  .ssli-acid-group-label {
    display: none; /* hide group captions on phone-land */
  }
  .ssli-acid-group-body {
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-sm);
  }
  .ssli-acid-field {
    gap: 1px;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .ssli-acid-field-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  .ssli-acid-select,
  .ssli-acid-number {
    padding: 2px 4px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
    min-width: 70px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-number {
    width: 54px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-range {
    width: 72px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-phrase-select {
    min-width: 82px;
    max-width: 130px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  .ssli-acid-category-select {
    min-width: 72px;
    max-width: 110px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  .ssli-acid-random-btn {
    padding: 2px 5px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
  }
  .ssli-acid-range-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    min-width: 28px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-seg-btn {
    padding: 2px 8px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
  }

  .ssli-acid-silhouette {
    height: var(--acid-silhouette-h);
    margin: 0 2px;
  }

  .ssli-acid-grid-area {
    padding: 1px 4px 0 4px;
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
  }
  .ssli-acid-grid {
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
    padding: 2px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-step {
    gap: 1px;
    padding: 1px 1px 2px 1px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-step-header {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs); /* phone-land typography floor 0.65rem */
    padding: 0;
    min-height: var(--acid-step-header-h);
    height: var(--acid-step-header-h);
    line-height: var(--acid-step-header-h);
  }
  .ssli-acid-step-note {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  .ssli-acid-step-pitch-btn {
    height: 22px;
    min-height: 22px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  .ssli-acid-pitchbar {
    height: var(--acid-pitchbar-h-land);
  }

  /* Phone-land: collapse tri-dot to single priority dot */
  .ssli-acid-dots .ssli-acid-dot {
    display: none;
  }
  .ssli-acid-dots .ssli-acid-dot.priority {
    display: block;
  }

  .ssli-acid-footer {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* Even tighter for iPhone SE landscape */
@media (max-height: 450px) and (max-width: 720px) {
  .ssli-acid-root {
    padding: 3px 5px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-header {
    padding-right: 52px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-controls {
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs) 6px;
    padding: 2px 4px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-select {
    min-width: 58px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  .ssli-acid-number {
    width: 42px;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
  .ssli-acid-range {
    width: 56px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-grid-area {
    padding: 1px 2px 0 2px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-grid {
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
    padding: 2px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-pitchbar {
    height: 18px;
  }
  .ssli-acid-step-note {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  }
}

/* ======= Drum-machine grid (phone-land) ======= */
/* Outside the SE-specific query so it applies to all phone-land viewports */
@media (max-height: 450px) {
  /* Hide the original column-per-step layout when drum grid is active */
  .ssli-acid-grid.ssli-acid-drum-grid {
    display: grid;
    /* 1 label column + N step columns */
    grid-template-columns: 32px repeat(var(--drum-step-count, 16), minmax(0, 1fr));
    grid-auto-rows: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: var(--ssli-gap-xs);
    padding: 2px;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
  .ssli-acid-grid.ssli-acid-drum-grid[data-stepcount="8"] {
    grid-template-columns: 32px repeat(8, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .ssli-acid-grid.ssli-acid-drum-grid[data-stepcount="16"] {
    grid-template-columns: 32px repeat(16, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  /* Corner cell (top-left, empty) */
  .ssli-acid-drum-corner {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    color: var(--acid-text-muted);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-semibold);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }

  /* Step number headers */
  .ssli-acid-drum-step-hdr {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: var(--acid-text-muted);
    min-height: 14px;
  }

  /* Row labels (note names) */
  .ssli-acid-drum-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    color: var(--acid-text-dim);
    background: var(--acid-bg-panel);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
    padding: 0 2px;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* Toggle cells — override global 28px min-height from acid touch-compact */
  .ssli-acid-drum-cell {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: var(--acid-bg-cell);
    border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0 !important;
    transition: background 0.1s, border-color 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s;
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-cell:hover {
    background: var(--acid-bg-cell-on);
    border-color: var(--acid-border-strong);
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-cell.lit {
    background: var(--acid-amber);
    border-color: var(--acid-amber);
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--acid-amber-glow);
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-cell.lit.accent {
    background: #ffb020;
    border-color: #ffb020;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--acid-amber-glow);
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-cell.lit.slide {
    border-color: var(--acid-cyan);
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--acid-amber-glow), 0 0 4px var(--acid-cyan-glow);
  }
  /* Playhead column highlight */
  .ssli-acid-drum-cell.playing-col {
    background: rgba(245, 197, 66, 0.18);
    border-color: var(--acid-amber-soft);
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-cell.lit.playing-col {
    background: #ffe066;
    border-color: #ffe066;
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--acid-amber-glow);
  }

  /* Control row (slide / accent per step) */
  .ssli-acid-drum-ctrl {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-ctrl.playing-col {
    /* subtle glow on control row during playhead */
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-ctrl-btn {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 14px !important;
    background: var(--acid-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--acid-border);
    border-radius: var(--ssli-radius-sm);
    color: var(--acid-text-muted);
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    font-weight: var(--ssli-fw-bold);
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0;
    transition: background 0.1s, color 0.1s;
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-ctrl-btn.slide-on {
    background: var(--acid-cyan);
    color: #0a0a14;
    border-color: var(--acid-cyan);
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-ctrl-btn.accent-on {
    background: var(--acid-amber);
    color: #0a0a14;
    border-color: var(--acid-amber);
  }
  .ssli-acid-drum-ctrl-label {
    font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
    color: var(--acid-text-muted);
  }

  /* Hide elements from column view that don't apply in drum grid mode */
  .ssli-acid-grid.ssli-acid-drum-grid .ssli-acid-step {
    display: none;
  }
  /* Hide slide arcs and silhouette in drum grid mode */
  .ssli-acid-grid-wrap:has(.ssli-acid-drum-grid) .ssli-acid-slide-svg {
    display: none;
  }
  /* Make the grid area fill available space */
  .ssli-acid-grid.ssli-acid-drum-grid ~ .ssli-acid-silhouette,
  .ssli-acid-drum-grid ~ .ssli-acid-empty-hint {
    display: none;
  }
  /* Grid area should expand */
  .ssli-acid-grid-area:has(.ssli-acid-drum-grid) {
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  /* Hide silhouette when drum grid is active */
  .ssli-acid-grid-area:has(.ssli-acid-drum-grid) .ssli-acid-silhouette {
    display: none;
  }
}


/* === ctrl-vowelpad.css === */
/* Vowel Pad surface styles */

.ssli-vowelpad-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  overflow: hidden;
  cursor: crosshair;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-control-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: var(--ssli-topbar-h);
  min-height: var(--ssli-topbar-h);
  padding: 2px 10px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  background: rgba(20, 20, 42, 0.8);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.12);
}

.ssli-vowelpad-pad-area {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #14142a 0%, #0a0a1a 100%);
  touch-action: none;
}

/* touch-action: none on interactive sub-elements (does not inherit) */

.ssli-vowelpad-grid-line {
  position: absolute;
  background: rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.3);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-grid-line-v {
  width: 1px;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-grid-line-h {
  height: 1px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-anchor-dot {
  position: absolute;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  transition: transform 0.15s ease;
  z-index: 2;
  touch-action: none;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-anchor-dot.nearest {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.2);
}

.ssli-vowelpad-anchor-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  color: var(--ssli-text-muted, #888);
  text-align: center;
  line-height: 1;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-cursor {
  position: absolute;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--ssli-accent) 0%, rgba(76, 201, 240, 0) 70%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.6);
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  display: none;
  z-index: 3;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-readout {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-sm);
  color: var(--ssli-text-primary);
  font-family: monospace;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-snap-btn {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}

.ssli-vowelpad-axis-label {
  position: absolute;
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  color: var(--ssli-text-muted);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-axis-label-x {
  bottom: 4px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.ssli-vowelpad-axis-label-y-top {
  top: 4px;
  left: 4px;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-axis-label-y-bottom {
  bottom: 4px;
  left: 4px;
}

.ssli-vowelpad-idle-hint {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-body);

}

.ssli-vowelpad-center-dot {

  left: 50%;

  border-radius: 50%;

/* Phone landscape overrides */
[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-vowelpad-control-bar {

[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-vowelpad-anchor-dot {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-vowelpad-anchor-label {

}

[data-layout="phone-land"] .ssli-vowelpad-axis-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
}

[data-layout="phone"] .ssli-vowelpad-control-bar {
  height: var(--ssli-topbar-h-phone);
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
  padding: 2px 6px;
}

[data-layout="phone"] .ssli-vowelpad-anchor-dot {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
}

[data-layout="phone"] .ssli-vowelpad-anchor-label {
  font-size: var(--ssli-fs-xs);
